notes.title: The Desktop Army Collaboration Event (Sylphy II) Updated!（2025/09/17）
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3717019196f33186771075d6bda5038caeb99450.jpg[/img]

MegaHouse's original content, the armed beautiful girl collection figure series, Desktop Army, has came to CosmicBreak Universal!

[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/events/20625]Click here for the details of The Desktop Army Collaboration Event (Sylphy II).[/url]




[h1]◆Event Update Overview[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/b4a86d4cf8b6c9e5d6e701927e148f94633f0e58.png[/img]
Titania Genbu and Titania Suzaku have arrived in the Cosmic Ark!
Sylphy II, the D-phone distributed by the carrier SENTINEL GLORY, and their rival dragoon's D-phones Titania Genbu and Titania Suzaku, have arrived at the Cosmic Ark!
Let's bring the fight with the Desktop Army!

[h2]Event Period[/h2]
After maintenance 9/17/2025 JST
Until maintenance 10/1/2025 JST




[h2]◆DTA Assault Battle[/h2]
A D-phone battle between rival carriers SENTINEL GLORY and dragoon will take place in the event area.
Heroes will choose a faction and fight alongside their D-phones in an epic battle!
Each time you participate in a DTA Assault Battle you can choose your side.
Clear rewards will vary for each faction, so be sure to join many battles!

[h3]Game Rules[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ba97aa189bd72d425c0148e3e3bbca85260c47e1.png[/img]
DTA Assault Battles can be challenged from the Event Area quests available from the Ground Area.
To participate in the challenge players will need [url=#entry"]DTA Assault Battle Entry Tickets[/url].

After moving to the game room, navigate to the side of the carrier you wish to support.
On the other side of the gate, the selected faction's D-phones can engage in mock battles.
After the mock battles, proceed to the subsequent gate to engage in warfare with the enemy carrier in a fight for dominance!
Fight together with your D-phone allies and leave your mark on the battlefield!

[h3]Prize Lineup[/h3]
In DTA Assault Battles, prizes will vary based on the faction players choose.
Please confirm the details below.
(Prizes will be received randomly from the lists below based on the chosen side.)

[b]・SENTINEL GLORY Side[/b]
[[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/events/20625]Returing Event[/url]] and [[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/12961]Shop[/url]] parts can be obtained to strengthen Sylphy II.
Choosing the SENTINEL GLORY side alows players to get parts for Sylphy II Intruder and Sylphy II Archangel!

Sylphy II Intruder


[b]・dragoon Side[/b]
[[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/events/20625]Returing Event[/url]] and [[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/12961]Shop[/url]] parts can be obtained to strengthen Sylphy II.

Another Sylphy II Light Cube can be obtained by fighting as the opposing faction as well.


[h3][How to Participate][/h3]
Press the F11 key to open the Quick Access menu and move to the Ground Area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/91cd6df81d8571f34655f71cc31a8711007c49a6.png[/img]

After moving, press the F3 key to open the Quest screen and select [Make Room].
From the Event Area, click on DTA Assault Battle and choose [Start Alone] to begin the fight!

notes.title: [Beta Test Room] Second Round of Rapid Match!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/5f7f8f3f512827009f8825b0a6c7c3565c4f2b27.png[/img]
[h1]◆[Beta Test Room] Union Wars: Rapid Match[/h1]
The [Beta Test Room], where new rules and items can be tested, is now open!
This beta test room introduces second round of Rapid Match, now with major feature improvements!

[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/news/19782]Click here to learn more about the development background and concept behind Rapid Match.[/url]


[h2]What is a Rapid Match?[/h2]
A feature that automatically creates rooms and matches players for Union Wars.
By pressing the Rapid Match button, you’ll enter a Matching state. Once enough players join, Union Wars will begin automatically.
Alternatively, you may join an ongoing Rapid Match battle that has not yet reached the maximum number of players.
In queued players can be viewed from the Union Wars tab or the top of the screen during matchmaking.
Opening the Garage or Shop will temporarily suspend the Matching status.

[h2]How to Join[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/807e8b6f0a0a3d584f6b767ae745e902f568f337.png[/img]
To join, open the Arena menu, select the Union Wars tab, and press the Rapid Match button.
To cancel participation, simply press the button again.

After a match ends, you can choose to continue participating in Rapid Match via the dialog that appears.

[h2]Event Period[/h2]
From maintenance 6/18/2025
Until maintenance 7/2/2025

[h2]Game Rule[/h2]
・Starting Players: 20 ~ 40
・Union Wars [20vs20]：Healing Power Spot
・Battle Rating Restriction: None
・Mid-match entry: Allowed.

[h2]Changes from the Previous Version[/h2]
"・A new indicator has been added to display the total number of players.
This total includes the following:"
- Players waiting for a Rapid Match
- Players temporarily removed from the match (e.g., in the Garage)
- Players currently engaged in a Rapid Match room
・Minimum and maximum player counts for matches have been adjusted.
・Mid-match joining is now enabled. When the matching phase begins, players will automatically join ongoing rooms that have not yet reached the full 20 vs 20 capacity.
・The queue time before matching begins has been reduced from 30 seconds to 10 seconds.

[h1]We Want Your Feedback![/h1]
The Beta Test Room is a game room available prior to official release.
We’re aiming to create a more enjoyable experience based on your feedback.
Your thoughts and suggestions are always welcome!

 [url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/inquiry/request]Click here to submit your feedback and requests.[/url]




[h1]◆In-Match Screen Overview[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/06835ce3fb05d7f5a032f15ea0cab18577381fe7.png[/img]
[h2]① Rapid Match Button[/h2]
This button allows you to join a Rapid Match or cancel your current standby status.
If it displays Matching, it means you are currently queued for a Rapid Match and waiting for enough players to begin. 

[h2]② Standby Player Count[/h2]
Displays the number of players currently waiting for a Rapid Match after pressing the button.
Once the number reaches the minimum required to start, the battle will begin.
※You may also join an ongoing match if there are open slots.

[h2]③ Total Player Count[/h2]
Displays the total number of players across the following categories.
・Players waiting for a Rapid Match
・Players temporarily removed from the match (e.g., in the Garage)
・Players currently participating in a Rapid Match battle
This is shown at the top of the screen under TOTAL.

[h2]④ Minimum Required Players[/h2]
Displays the minimum number of players needed to begin a match.
Once the number of standby players exceeds this value, the battle will begin.

[h2]⑤ Matchmaking Timer[/h2]
Displays the time remaining before the next round of matchmaking begins.
If the timer reaches zero and there are enough standby players, a new battle will begin. If open slots exist in ongoing rooms, mid-match joining will occur.

[h2]⑥ Standby / Minimum Players[/h2]
Displays a concise view of both the current Standby Player count and the Minimum Required player count.

[h2]⑦ Starting Stage[/h2]
Displays the stage where the next battle will take place.
※If you join mid-match, the stage may differ from the one displayed here.

notes.title: [Beta Test Room] Introducing Rapid Match!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/407d97d5d5d89fce5e54fc23995f60f491b2e1ba.png[/img]
[h1]◆[Beta Test Room] Introducing Rapid Match![/h1]
The [Beta Test Room], where new rules and items can be tested, is now open!
This beta test room introduces Rapid Match, a new feature that auto-creates rooms for Union Wars!


[h2]Rapid Match[/h2]
A feature that automatically creates rooms and matches players for Union Wars.
By pressing the Rapid Match button, you’ll enter a Matching state. Once enough players join, Union Wars will begin automatically.
In queued players can be viewed from the Union Wars tab or the top of the screen during matchmaking.
Opening the Garage or Shop will temporarily suspend the Matching status.

[h2]How to Join[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/b5c52b4c87ded81ff640c60453ff77fa5f30c34c.png[/img]
To join, open the Arena menu, select the Union Wars tab, and press the Rapid Match button.
To cancel participation, simply press the button again.

After a match ends, you can choose to continue participating in Rapid Match via the dialog that appears.

[h2]Event Period[/h2]
From maintenance 4/23/2025
Until maintenance 5/8/2025

[h2]Game Rule[/h2]
・Starting Players: 40 ~ 60
・Union Wars [30vs30]: NPC & Healing Power Spot"
・Battle Rating Restriction: None
※Mid-match entry is not allowed.

[h1]We want your feedback![/h1]
The [Beta Test Room] is a game room made available before an official release.
Based on feedback from players, we aim to create a room that will provide an even better game experience.
We look forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback!

[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/inquiry/request]Please share your feedback here.[/url]




[h1]◆What is the Beta Test Room?[/h1]
The Beta Test Room is a space where various new game rules are tested.
We plan to introduce here challenging game rules and new maps.

With the Beta Test Rooms, we aim to quickly develop, improve, and implement new content based on players' feedback.[br
While enjoying the game, we encourage you to share your thoughts and impressions on the new rules.
Providing feedback is a vital part of the development process.
Our ultimate goal is to establish new fun game rules and release them officially.

The feedback you provide will serve as an important reference for future development.




Thank you for supporting CosmicBreak Universal!

notes.title: Season 17 Battle Campaign
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/c319385315f3445ff730a4e36213b18bec265811.jpg[/img]

The CosmicBreak Universal [[b]Season 17 Battle Campaign[/b]] has begun!

[h2]◆What is the Battle Campiagn?[/h2]
The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period.
The number of battle cards you have and battle campaign rewards can be checked by pressing the Battle Pass button or the F5 key in-game.

Please check in-game for Battle Campaign rewards.


[h1][Premium Piece][/h1]
From Season 10 onwards, players will be able to receive the [Premium Piece] as a Battle Campaign reward.
Premium pieces are items that can be exchanged for new characters from the previous season.
The characters that can be exchanged vary depending on the number collected, so collect a lot and get the character you want!

Please take Premium Pieces to the Premium Piece Counter to exchange for characters.

[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/info/topic/general/18430]Click here for details on Current Premium Piece Rewards[/url]




[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1]
[h3]◆250, 700, 1400 Card Prize：A-MSL Select Box[/h3]
This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate M Slayer. The Alternate are Limited Edition weapons with a special look that can only be obtained here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/a574861c2be36624f22d37073543faefc18f850e.png[/img]
[h3]◆550 Card Prize：Rouche Lab[/h3]
This is "Rouche" dressed as a speciall costume!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/0516c4a9cbe1010243414ea9163a2d0c7ca95894.png[/img]
[h3]Campaign Period[/h3]
After maintenance 4/2/2025 JST
Until maintenance 7/2/2025 JST
*A battle campaign will be held each season, with each season lasting three months.

[h1]About the Battle Pass[/h1]
Available for 300Rt, this item will make the player eligible for luxury rewards exclusive to battle pass purchasers!
These rewards include exclusive items and Garapon Tickets.

[h3]How to Get a Battle Pass[/h3]
A Battle Pass can be purchased from the in-game Shop in the "ITEM" section for 300 Rt.
"Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on ""Charge Rt"".
"
*You can still receive rewards even if you purchase the Battle Pass after a Season has started.




[h2]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/h2]
All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.
[table][tr][td ]Arena[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]Union Wars Battle Rooms[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]Event Battle[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]Union Wars [UNION][/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]Union Wars [ARK][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3]How to Get Battle Cards[/h3]
Battle Cards can be obtained based on wins, losses, and battle results in valid Union Wars rooms.
※The amount of cards that can be earned from a match varies depending on the conditions set for the room. Please see the chart below for additional details.

[h2]Breakdown of Cards Earned[/h2]
[table][tr][td ]Match[/td][td ]Condition[/td][td]Earned[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]15vs15[/td][td ]Win[/td][td ]x6[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]15vs15[/td][td ]Loss[/td][td ]x5[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]20vs20[/td][td ]Win[/td][td ]x6[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]20vs20[/td][td ]Loss[/td][td ]x5[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]30vs30[/td][td ]Win[/td][td ]x6[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]30vs30[/td][td ]Loss[/td][td ]x5[/td][/tr][/table]
※ In order to get cards, at least 10 players must be participating in the match.
※ Players whose consumed BP has reached more than 6,500 will not receive cards.
※Players who join in the middle of a match will not receive cards.

[h2]Rewards for Actions[/h2]
Players will be awarded at the end of matches based on the actions they took during the match.
Depending on the number of participants in the match, the top players in the ranking of each award will get 1 additional Battle Card each.
※The amount of players who can receive an additional reward will vary depending on the number of participants in a match.
[table][tr][td ]Participants[/td][td ]Placement[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]15～19[/td][td ]1st[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]20～25[/td][td ]1～2[/td][/tr]
[tr][td ]26～30[/td][td ]1～3[/td][/tr][/table]
※There must be at least 15 players participating in the match in order to earn additional rewards.
※Additional cards cannot be earned if a player has won a match, as they are already at the earnable limit.

[h2]Please Note:[/h2]
-Battle Cards will be removed at the end of the Season.

notes.title: [Beta Test Room] Wide Stage Addition!
notes.content:
[h1]◆[Beta Test] Union Wars: Wide Stage[/h1]
The [Beta Test Room], where new rules and items can be tested, is now open!
In this Beta Test Room, you can play four types of 'Wide Stages', which are also scheduled to be added to the regular Union Wars at a later date!

[h2]Wide Stage[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3c9c05df15d1080baa040a4265b0458cc7b47b4d.png[/img]

4 time-limited stages are available in this [Beta Test Room]! These 4 stages are:
The expanded version of the popular stage 'Red Leaves'; 'Wide Red Leaves', as well as the new stages "Kappa City", "Ruined Base", and the "Halloween Park" stage that was added during this year's Halloween limited-time Event!

[h2]Changes from before[/h2]
・The rule has been changed to [20vs20]: Healing Power Spot.
・NPCs will no longer participate in the battles.
・Standard matchmaking has been applied.
・The room display has been moved from the Arena's 'Event Battle' tab to the 'Union Wars' tab.

[h2]Event Period[/h2]
From maintenance 12/11/2024 JST
Until maintenance 12/18/2024 JST

[h1]We want your feedback![/h1]
The [Beta Test Room] is a game room made available before an official release.
Based on feedback from players, we aim to create a room that will provide an even better game experience.
We look forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback!

[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/inquiry/request]Please share your feedback here.[/url]

For feedback on the official Discord server: [url=https://discord.com/channels/978600990209114122/1001691769538359396]Here[/url]




[h1]◆What is the Beta Test Room?[/h1]
The Beta Test Room is a space where various new game rules are tested.
We plan to introduce here challenging game rules and new maps.

With the Beta Test Rooms, we aim to quickly develop, improve, and implement new content based on players' feedback.[br
While enjoying the game, we encourage you to share your thoughts and impressions on the new rules.
Providing feedback is a vital part of the development process.
Our ultimate goal is to establish new fun game rules and release them officially.

The feedback you provide will serve as an important reference for future development.




Thank you for supporting CosmicBreak Universal!

[h1]◆What Are Faction Battles?[/h1]
For a limited time, participate in Faction Battles, where you can choose your favorite faction and compete against the opposing Faction for the highest score!!

※The schedule will be announced in-game on relevant days as well.

notes.content:
During maintenance on 8/21/2024 JST, a major overhaul of tutorial-related content wil be implemented!
Additionally, various quality of life updates will also be implemented during this maintenance.

For improvements not mentioned in this article, please refer to the maintenance article of August 21, 2024 JST.

If you are unsure how to proceed with your Orders, you can press the [?] button in the top right to display a guide that explains how to proceed with Orders. 

In addition,Tutorial Orders can be attempted by all Heroes, even those who have already played the story of CosmicBreak Universal!

[h3]Guaranteed Gold Garapon[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/33b0100ab6763dbc976cf788498169cd6e3fb8a7.png[/img]
The Guaranteed Gold Garapon Ticket, which can be obtained by clearing all Tutorial Orders, is a ticket that allows the player to roll the Guaranteed Gold Garapon, which ensures the players receive a Gold tier Robot!
Take this chance to get strong robots early and get ahead in the Arena!


[h3]Step Up Cube [/h3]This item allows players to win great prizes every time they clear the set conditions.
Use the cube and fulfill all the conditions to get an SP Garapon Ticket, which can be used to roll  the Hero Garapon!

※The screen is under development and may differ from the actual specs in some instances.
※This function can be toggled on and off from Options >> Display & Sound >> UI Display.

[h2]◆Chapter 3: New Powers[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/355fae2615f0eb6a66f97e50e22e8ab74e612e3f.png[/img]
With repairs now completed and operational testing by Hateck's recruited pilots now complete, ExCreR can be said to have regained its original power.
But in his research, Dr Hateck found a blueprint within the black box of ExCreR's data.
As Dr Hatek realizes that he will need combat data to bring this blueprint to life, he turns to you and other chosen pilots to gather data on combat conditions. 

Talk to Dr Hateck in the Ground Area to join the [Vs ExCreR] event!
By winning the battle, playerscan get special weapons and accessories related to ExCreR!
[b]※Players can participate in Episode 3: New Power even if theyhave not progressed through the original Pt 1, Episode 1: Damaged in a Flash of Light and Episode 2: Pilot Applications events, though they are recommended to best enjoy Episode 3.

Participation in this battle will require a VS ExCreR Entryticket.

In this quest, two of the renewed crafts, ExCreR and the ExCreR Gustclaw, await your challenge, piloted by familiar faces.

[h1]◆What Are Faction Battles?[/h1]
For a limited time, participate in Faction Battles, where you can choose your favorite faction and compete against the opposing Faction for the highest score!!
Collect points by participating in arena battles and get various rewards as well!

※The schedule will be announced in-game on relevant days as well.

[h1]How to Join[/h1]
First, talk to the [Faction Battle Counter] in the [Central Area] in the game and select the faction to join.
When selecting a faction, you will receive a limited participation prize!
When it's time for a faction match, join the [Faction Battles] in the [Event Battle] tab!
At the end of the event period, the Faction's total score will determine the outcome.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/934bb74cf68c4aa7f2012588f2557e80ba7658ec.png[/img]

At the end of the event, a [Core Tune] with the motif of the winning faction will appear!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/575c18627a3924d18fba2a1a7edb970be8a46073.png[/img]

[h2]◆DTA Assault Battle[/h2]A D-phone battle between rival carriers SENTINEL GLORY and dragoon will take place in the event area.

The CosmicBreak Universal [[b]Season 13 Battle Campaign[/b]] has begun!

[h2]◆What is the Battle Campiagn?[/h2]The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period.
The number of battle cards you have and battle campaign rewards can be checked by pressing the Battle Pass button or the F5 key in-game.

Please check in-game for Battle Campaign rewards.


[h1][Premium Piece][/h1]From Season 10 onwards, players will be able to receive the [Premium Piece] as a Battle Campaign reward.
Premium pieces are items that can be exchanged for new characters from the previous season.
The characters that can be exchanged vary depending on the number collected, so collect a lot and get the character you want!

Please take Premium Pieces to the Premium Piece Counter to exchange for characters.



[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1][h3]◆250, 700, 1300 Card Prize：A-CMB Select Box[/h3]This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate CM Burner. The Alternate are Limited Edition weapons with the same functionality as the CM Burner, but with a special look that can only be obtained here!

Until maintenance 7/3/2024 JST

These rewards include exclusive items and Garapon Tickets.

"Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on ""Charge Rt"".

[h2]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/h2]All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.

notes.title: Faction Battles Begin!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/154e743cbe8e79bf21d965d2824667c08617fe9e.png[/img]

[h1]◆What Are Faction Battles?[/h1]
For a limited time, participate in Faction Battles, where you can choose your favorite faction and compete against the opposing Faction for the highest score!!
Collect points by participating in arena battles and get various rewards as well!

※The schedule will be announced in-game on relevant days as well.

[h1]How to Join[/h1]
First, talk to the [Faction Battle Counter] in the [Central Area] in the game and select the faction to join.
When selecting a faction, you will receive a limited participation prize!
When it's time for a faction match, join the [Faction Battles] in the [Event Battle] tab!
At the end of the event period, the Faction's total score will determine the outcome.

notes.title: Season 12 Battle Campaign
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/b3e82e4a3b86ead4f645208902855bd406ca57d5.jpg[/img]
Throw yourself into the thrill of battle in the Union Wars and receive a variety of unique items during the [b]Season 12 Battle Campaign[/b]!

[h1]What is the Battle Campaign?[/h1]The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period.
The number of battle cards you have and battle campaign rewards can be checked by pressing the Battle Pass button or the F5 key in-game.

Please check in-game for Battle Campaign rewards.


[h1][Premium Piece][/h1]From Season 10 onwards, players will be able to receive the [Premium Piece] as a Battle Campaign reward.
Premium pieces are items that can be exchanged for new characters from the previous season.
The characters that can be exchanged vary depending on the number collected, so collect a lot and get the character you want!

Please take Premium Pieces to the Premium Piece Counter to exchange for characters.



[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1][h3]◆250, 700, 1300 Card Prize：A-PBCSelect Box[/h3]This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate PB Cannon. The Alternate are Limited Edition weapons with the same functionality as the PB Cannon, but with a special look that can only be obtained here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/c36dca21a25a9f02b90f9f324cf66f7774501846.png[/img]

[h3]◆550 Card Prize：Mercurio Lsk[/h3]Mercurio in a special costume, a long sleeved kimono!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/a76569bc268fd5a5453289cfb0d6db5b84d2dc3c.png[/img]

[h3]Campaign Period[/h3]After maintenance 1/10/2024 JST
Until maintenance 4/3/2024 JST
*A battle campaign will be held each season, with each season lasting three months.

[h1]About the Battle Pass[/h1]Available for 300Rt, this item will make the player eligible for luxury rewards exclusive to battle pass purchasers!
These rewards include exclusive items and Garapon Tickets.

[h3]How to Get a Battle Pass[/h3]A Battle Pass can be purchased from the in-game Shop in the "ITEM" section for 300 Rt.
"Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on ""Charge Rt"".
"*You can still receive rewards even if you purchase the Battle Pass after a Season has started.



[h2]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/h2]All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.
[table][tr][td]Arena[/td][/tr][tr][td]Union Wars Battle Rooms[/td][/tr][tr][td]Event Battle[/td][/tr][tr][td]Union Wars [UNION][/td][/tr][tr][td]Union Wars [ARK][/td][/tr][/table]
[h3]How to Get Battle Cards[/h3]Battle Cards can be obtained based on wins, losses, and battle results in valid Union Wars rooms.
※The amount of cards that can be earned from a match varies depending on the conditions set for the room. Please see the chart below for additional details.

[h2]Breakdown of Cards Earned[/h2][table][tr][td]Match[/td][td]Condition[/td][td]Earned[/td][/tr][tr][td]15vs15[/td][td]Win[/td][td]x6[/td][/tr][tr][td]15vs15[/td][td]Loss[/td][td]x5[/td][/tr][tr][td]30vs30[/td][td]Win[/td][td]x6[/td][/tr][tr][td]30vs30[/td][td]Loss[/td][td]x5[/td][/tr][/table]※ In order to get cards, at least 10 players must be participating in the match.
※ Players whose consumed BP has reached more than 6,500 will not receive cards.
※Players who join in the middle of a match will not receive cards.

[h2]Rewards for Actions[/h2]Players will be awarded at the end of matches based on the actions they took during the match.
Depending on the number of participants in the match, the top players in the ranking of each award will get 1 additional Battle Card each.
※The amount of players who can receive an additional reward will vary depending on the number of participants in a match.
[table][tr][td]Participants[/td][td]Placement[/td][/tr][tr][td]14～19[/td][td]1st[/td][/tr][tr][td]20～25[/td][td]1～2[/td][/tr][tr][td]26～30[/td][td]1～3[/td][/tr][/table]※There must be at least 14 players participating in the match in order to earn additional rewards.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3bb0d811c24ce035b5a3b6d73c3a2247c6e04a99.png[/img]

[h1]◆What Are Faction Battles?[/h1]
For a limited time, participate in Faction Battles, where you can choose your favorite faction and compete against the opposing Faction for the highest score!!
Collect points by participating in arena battles and get various rewards as well!

※The schedule will be announced in-game on relevant days as well.

[h1]How to Join[/h1]
First, talk to the [Faction Battle Counter] in the [Central Area] in the game and select the faction to join.
When selecting a faction, you will receive a limited participation prize!
When it's time for a faction match, join the [Faction Battles] in the [Event Battle] tab!
At the end of the event period, the Faction's total score will determine the outcome.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/1b33c677558d4a9747fd443f2c03c791efdf396c.png[/img]

Lead your faction to victory!

Let's admore the records of past Heroes!

notes.title: Season 11 Battle Campaign
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/c18a7b01210a657d4f8f0344268c409843dc9c6f.jpg[/img]
Throw yourself into the thrill of battle in the Union Wars and receive a variety of unique items during the [b]Season 11 Battle Campaign[/b]!

[h1]What is the Battle Campaign?[/h1]The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period.
The number of battle cards you have and battle campaign rewards can be checked by pressing the Battle Pass button or the F5 key in-game.

Please check in-game for Battle Campaign rewards.


[h1][Premium Piece][/h1]From Season 10 onwards, players will be able to receive the [Premium Piece] as a Battle Campaign reward.
Premium pieces are items that can be exchanged for new characters from the previous season.
The characters that can be exchanged vary depending on the number collected, so collect a lot and get the character you want!

[h3]Season 11 Premium Pass Rewards[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/5e09e02e6095605bd9e4c24a0c43604b3304a34a.png[/img]
Please take Premium Pieces to the Premium Piece Counter to exchange for characters.



[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1][h3]◆250, 700, 1300 Card Prize：A-SCL Select Box[/h3]This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate S Launcher. The Alternate are Limited Edition weapons with the same functionality as the S Lancher, but with a special look that can only be obtained here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/24ff5d5c4fb93fbf19108b6273d24bbd059ed6a4.png[/img]

[h3]◆550 Card Prize：Aletta Bny[/h3]Aletta Arpeggio in a special, exciting bunny costume!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/1c26bff2fb74ed839853d6da1cdeb373db76d99b.png[/img]

[h3]Campaign Period[/h3]After maintenance 10/4/2023 JST
Until maintenance 1/10/2024 JST
*A battle campaign will be held each season, with each season lasting three months.

[h1]About the Battle Pass[/h1]Available for 300Rt, this item will make the player eligible for luxury rewards exclusive to battle pass purchasers!
These rewards include exclusive items and Garapon Tickets.

[h3]How to Get a Battle Pass[/h3]A Battle Pass can be purchased from the in-game Shop in the "ITEM" section for 300 Rt.
"Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on ""Charge Rt"".
"*You can still receive rewards even if you purchase the Battle Pass after a Season has started.



[h2]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/h2]All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/6ba5a137d782f67a2f46d53f9961a4abacd06348.png[/img]
[h3]How to Get Battle Cards[/h3]Battle Cards can be obtained based on wins, losses, and battle results in valid Union Wars rooms.
※The amount of cards that can be earned from a match varies depending on the conditions set for the room. Please see the chart below for additional details.

[h2]Breakdown of Cards Earned[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/8c80aeff1741c535c7e4c534b28cd9f9d966703d.png[/img]※ In order to get cards, at least 10 players must be participating in the match.
※ Players whose consumed BP has reached more than 6,500 will not receive cards.
※Players who join in the middle of a match will not receive cards.

[h2]Rewards for Actions[/h2]Players will be awarded at the end of matches based on the actions they took during the match.
Depending on the number of participants in the match, the top players in the ranking of each award will get 1 additional Battle Card each.
※The amount of players who can receive an additional reward will vary depending on the number of participants in a match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/2c63e4f8ee2caee4c514c24472fab2d5d4f54254.png[/img]※There must be at least 14 players participating in the match in order to earn additional rewards.
※Additional cards cannot be earned if a player has won a match, as they are already at the earnable limit.

[h2]Please Note:[/h2]-Battle Cards will be removed at the end of the Season.

notes.title: Faction Battles Begin!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/79e5ee84ddf3cf6f0fe18ed0636d603e77faff92.png[/img]

[h1]◆What Are Faction Battles?[/h1]
For a limited time, participate in Faction Battles, where you can choose your favorite faction and compete against the opposing Faction for the highest score!!
Collect points by participating in arena battles and get various rewards as well!

※The schedule will be announced in-game on relevant days as well.

[h1]How to Join[/h1]
First, talk to the [Faction Battle Counter] in the [Central Area] in the game and select the faction to join.
When selecting a faction, you will receive a limited participation prize!
When it's time for a faction match, join the [Faction Battles] in the [Event Battle] tab!
At the end of the event period, the Faction's total score will determine the outcome.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/181aa1a324bb68b84eaeb4856e34033ca08e2e31.png[/img]

[h3]Match Timing[/h3]
・15vs15
With the exception 30vs30 matches, events will be held for 2 days.

・30vs30
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3e1579c5924f261d82c55e7d9d6091a7cc48e24b.jpg[/img]


[h1]Rewards[/h1]Earn various rewards by participating in Faction Battles!
At the end of the event, a [Core Tune] with the motif of the winning faction will appear!

[h3]Participation Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/575c18627a3924d18fba2a1a7edb970be8a46073.png[/img]

[h3]Faction Ranking Rewards[/h3]
You can get great rewards depending on the ranking of your faction.
Lead your faction to victory!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/5b430672ecef4bc0b7fe8077fca27a2ce8a65824.png[/img]


[h2]◆List of Past Results[/h2]
The results of all of the faction battles thus far will be detailed below.
Let's admore the records of past Heroes!

[h3]Result List[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/2b03bbcb33d488d3ea1b795899fcd417ac3e8680.png[/img]
※ Winning Factions will be colored.



[h2]◆How to obtain Core Tune-Up and Mini Doll [/h2]
Mini Dolls and Core Tune-Ups from past events are still available.

[h3]Core Tune-Up[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ebbfc12418803e9a29936d42fad8193c1b1e63fd.png[/img]
Core Tune-Up is a Cosmo Builder Function than tunes up robots' BD parts.
BD performance does not change, but Core Tune-Up changes the aura and landing sound of the robot.
Core Tune-Up requires items such as Cosmos Plates and Gems.
Materials and items can also be found in the Random Planet Arcantus.

[h3]Mini Doll[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/c2d74ab4cc734ac82dc2a066e2a84f8d00781425.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/fa7a83bbe8aaec0544f079cfe4158da0646eea76.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 3rd Chibi Character Union Wars：Bomb and Destroy Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/d3b8f3ed7218256a7b4d26a27c027ab67833a632.png[/img]

[h1]What is the Chibi Character Union Wars：Bomb and Destroy?[/h1]A special edition of the Chibi Union Wars, battles limited to Chibi characters!
Players will now be able to look for the tremendously powerful Bombs in the chibi character Union Wars!
The damage caused by Bombs will be extravagant, and may even take out your enemies with one shot!
Take your favorite chibi characters on an explosively fun mission in Union Wars Bomb and Destroy!
※3 Chibi characters will need to be set in the Commando to participate.
※Chibi Characters can be obtained in the Shop, Coin Exchanges, and Angel Force events.

[h2]Bomb[/h2]There are four types of Bombs in total.
・Bomb Bombs can be installed directly in-place.
・Dash Bomb Bombs will move directly forward after placement.
・Jumbo Bomb Bombs will jump forward immediately after placement.
・Anti Gravity Bombs will create a force field keeping enemies from getting too close for a period of time.

Each type of bomb will be randomly and continually generated by Bomb Pots on the stage.
Each team has a Bomb Pot, and players can obtain Bombs from their own team's Pot repeatedly. Players can only obtain Bombs from the enemy's Pot periodically.

notes.title: 4th Large-Scale Battle Campaign Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/a92ffe0ff54288bf845e7bda09572a19ebab2a35.png[/img]

The 3 Guardians have decided to prepare a [b]grand new arena for a large number of heroes[/b] to battle in order to collect more Cosmos! 

[b]50 vs 50[/b] battles can take place in this new arena!
Players can receive [b]Cosmo Harmonics[/b] by participating.

[b]Prepare for the fiercest battle you've ever experienced in the Arena![/b]

[h2]Event Period[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/116da1def134fd77c4ba100dc524d02a0d6d826f.png[/img]
[h2]Event Details[/h2][b]A large-scale 50 vs 50 Battle Campaign will be held![/b]
Throughout the event period, [b]a new Union Wars [50vs50] option will be added to the Event Battle section of the Arena[/b]. 

The main objective in Large-Scale Battles is to bring the enemy team's BP down to 0, which can be done most effectively [b]by destroying the enemy team's 5 Power Spots.[/b]
[b]Destroying a Power Spot will reduce the enemy team's BP by 20%, so be sure to attack them whenever possible![/b] Furthermore, [b]each team will have 1 large Power Spot worth 30% of the team BP, so don't miss any chances to destroy it![/b]
 
Finally, there will also be [b]a mounted turret[/b] available in Large-Scale Battle stages, perfect for wreaking havoc on your enemies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/73419fa37876c1bb68ad9834e7ed6c360f90839a.png[/img]

Receive [b]Cosmo Harmonics 10%[/b] by participating in a match! You can also receive additional items like [b]Cosmo Harmonics 20% and Cosmo Harmonics 10%[/b] at random. Furthermore, you can receive [b]more Coins than you would from a standard Union Wars battle![/b]

You can participate as many times as you'd like during the event's active hours, so collect all of the items you need!

The following rules will be active in Rooms for this event.
-During the event's active hours, 3 Rooms will be added to the Event Battles section.
-A match will not begin if the number of participants in a Room is below 60 players.
-If the number of participants in the room exceeds a certain number after the match, only randomly selected players will remain in the room, and all other players will be ejected from the room.

We hope you enjoy the event!
　
Thank you for playing CosmicBreak Universal.

- Choosing [Compensation Material] will return the material linked to the specific Tune-Up. Using this item in a Tune-Up grants it a 100% success rate.
Example: Choose a [Compensation Material] for a [High Power]  tune-up to receive a [High Power] tune-up material.
※Target parts for compensation include all parts.
※Tune ups can be cancelled to receive compensation materials up to a total of 100 times.
※Compansation materials can be collected until 10:00 7/19/2023 JST.
[/code]


We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience and understanding.
Thank you for your support of CosmicBreak Universal!

notes.title: Season 10 Battle Campaign
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ce8bbf75ed3c39e01c54afa5cbe3439f387bb25c.jpg[/img]
Throw yourself into the thrill of battle in the Union Wars and receive a variety of unique items during the [b]Season 10 Battle Campaign[/b]!

[h1]What is the Battle Campaign?[/h1]The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period.
The number of battle cards you have and battle campaign rewards can be checked by pressing the Battle Pass button or the F5 key in-game.

Please check in-game for Battle Campaign rewards.


[h1]New Reward [Premium Piece][/h1]During Season 10 players will be able to receive the [Premium Piece] reward, a new addition.
Premium pieces are items that can be exchanged for new characters from the previous season.
The characters that can be exchanged vary depending on the number collected, so collect a lot and get the character you want!

[h3]Season 10 Premium Piece rewards[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/af492a8e50b81093e7830b4584593422ba441ddd.png[/img]
Please take Premium Pieces to the Premium Piece Counter to exchange for characters.



[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1][h3]◆250, 700, 1300 Card Prize: A-ATA Select Box[/h3]This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate T Axe. The Alternate are Limited Edition weapons with the same functionality as the T Axe, but with a special look that can only be obtained here!
※The Alter T Axe is a limited weapon with a special appearance that has the same performance as the Tornado Axe weapon scheduled for a later implementation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/46c3b1c5eae83db97cd0c776bfd0e50199d1b865.png[/img]

[h3]◆550 Card Prize: Elisalotte Fml[/h3]Admire this special bridal Elisalotte!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3702624dfc70afa5c9b7d13f34db62ee2ebdd1dc.png[/img]

[h3]Campaign Period [/h3]After maintenance 7/5/2023 JST
Until maintenance 10/4/2023 JST
*A battle campaign will be held each season, with each season lasting three months.

[h1]About the Battle Pass[/h1]Available for 300Rt, this item will make the player eligible for luxury rewards exclusive to battle pass purchasers!
These rewards include exclusive items and Garapon Tickets.

[h3]How to Get a Battle Pass[/h3]A Battle Pass can be purchased from the in-game Shop in the "ITEM" section for 300 Rt.
"Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on ""Charge Rt"".
"*You can still receive rewards even if you purchase the Battle Pass after a Season has started.



[h2]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/h2]All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/6ba5a137d782f67a2f46d53f9961a4abacd06348.png[/img]
[h3]How to Get Battle Cards[/h3]Battle Cards can be obtained based on wins, losses, and battle results in valid Union Wars rooms.
※The amount of cards that can be earned from a match varies depending on the conditions set for the room. Please see the chart below for additional details.

[h2]Breakdown of Cards Earned[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/8c80aeff1741c535c7e4c534b28cd9f9d966703d.png[/img]※ In order to get cards, at least 10 players must be participating in the match.
※ Players whose consumed BP has reached more than 6,500 will not receive cards.
※Players who join in the middle of a match will not receive cards.

[h2]Rewards for Actions[/h2]Players will be awarded at the end of matches based on the actions they took during the match.
Depending on the number of participants in the match, the top players in the ranking of each award will get 1 additional Battle Card each.
※The amount of players who can receive an additional reward will vary depending on the number of participants in a match.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/2c63e4f8ee2caee4c514c24472fab2d5d4f54254.png[/img]※There must be at least 14 players participating in the match in order to earn additional rewards.
※Additional cards cannot be earned if a player has won a match, as they are already at the earnable limit.

[h2]Please Note:[/h2]-Battle Cards will be removed at the end of the Season.

For a limited time, participate in Faction Battles, where you can choose your favorite faction and compete against the opposing Faction for the highest score!!

notes.content:
Greetings from the Cosmic Break Universal service team.

CyberStep, Inc. is pleased to announce the release of the brand new sandbox game "TERAVIT" for PC / Steam is now available as of [b]April 20th, 2023 15:00 (JST).[/b]

To commemorate the release, amazing campaigns such as the [b]"1,000,000 Yen Split Prize Campaign"[/b], in which 1,000,000 Yen will be split among all participants, and the [b]"Release Campaign"[/b] where players can get up to 1,000 Jewels (In-game currency) by logging in or clearing worlds.

In addition, the Nintendo Switch version and smartphone version will be released in late May 2023, with the PlayStation 4 and 5 version releases planned for June 2023.

[url=https://teravit.app/en][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/7d3bfcfebab6abe01f2a870d95e816bf7ca3f3c3.jpg[/img]

TERAVIT Official Website
https://teravit.app/en[/url]


[h1]■ PC/Steam Versions of TERAVIT Released April 20th, 2023 15:00 (JST)![/h1]The PC/Steam versions of the new Free-to-play Sandbox Game TERAVIT is now available as of April 20th, 2023 15:00 (JST). 

[h3][u]◆ A Sandbox Game with the three main elements of "Create, Play, and Share".[/u][/h3]Create your own world by combining various gimmicks, wear your favorite avatar within the worlds, and make your creation public to play with others in this multiplayer title.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/6b3ce0c0f5c961ea0d9bee64f36fe041ccb1675c.png[/img]


[h3][u]◆ “Create to Earn” Game Model for Creators to Make Returns[/u][/h3][b]“Create to Earn”[/b] is a unique game model of "TERAVIT" where creators can [b]earn returns[/b] when other players play their created worlds or purchase items in the world.

By registering for the [b]"Creators Site",[/b] you can receive returns from your created "World Items" and "Avatars"! Check the official website announcement for more information for more details.

Announcement URL:[url=https://teravit.app/contents/index.html?category=content-en&id=16969]https://teravit.app/contents/index.html?category=content-en&id=16969[/url]


[h3][u]◆ More Releases to Follow on Various Platforms[/u][/h3]This game supports cross-play, so worlds created in the PC/Steam version can be played by players of other platforms scheduled for release in the future.

Those who are waiting for the Nintendo Switch and smartphone versions, scheduled for release in late May, or the PlayStation 4 and 5 versions, scheduled for release in June, should also check out the PC/Steam versions to see what kind of worlds other players are creating.

notes.title: [Updated]2nd Anniversary Celebration Event Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/9ef4d82cb70a94312590986ab506128cec530a7c.jpg[/img]

Thank you for helping CosmicBreak Universal reach its second anniversary!
In honor of the occassion we will be hosting a number of extravagant events!

[h1]■ CBUNI Campaign Girl Election 2023[/h1]In commemoration of the 2nd anniversary, we will be holding an election to choose the next face of CBUNI!
Players will get to choose between all of the characters entered between April 2022 to March 2023 to become the next poster girl of CBUNI.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/8f6f99cfa4963c751f9e3168ef2c3eff6502989b.png[/img]

Elections will be held throughout Season 9.
Elections will be held using the [Voting Ticket] in the [Voting Set] which can be obtained by completing various game modes.
Please speak to the [Election Personnel] NPC in the Resort Area to cast your vote.

[b]Voting Place[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/2e56239e1b29a3bdc93fdc49352122eb033a3107.png[/img]

[b]Election Schedule[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/1955aff2f837bbba2b02824e39426730b685c4f2.png[/img]

[h3]Preliminaries[/h3]In the prelims, a total of 54 candidates will be added into voting blocks of 5 candidates each.
Each block (A block, B block, C block, D block, E block) has a corresponding Vote Ticket. (Example: A Block voting ticket → Vote Ticket A)
Opening the [Voting Set] will give players access to the Vote Tickets for each block.
The top 6 characters of each block will be selected to advance to the next round!
Look for which characters are featured in each block in-game!


[h3]1st Round[/h3]In the main competition players will have the chance to vote for each block.
The 30 characters who won the prelim round will be assigned to one of three blocks, for a total of 10 characters in each block.
The same as in the prelims, players can cast their vote with [Vote Tickets] available from [Voting Sets].
A total of 12 characters, 4 from each block, willl advance to the final round!

[h3]Semifinals[/h3]The semifinals will have no block divisions, and of the 12 participants, 3 characters will proceed to the final round!
Players will have a chance to vote on these 3 winners in the final round.

[h3]Finals[/h3]The final round will not divide characters into blocks.

notes.title: Season 9 Battle Campaign
notes.content:
[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/10404]	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/d9c4709ca7dd18204b6fbdf349d401fbe13f5726.jpg[/img]
[/url]
	
	Throw yourself into the thrill of battle in the Union Wars and receive a variety of unique items during the [b]Season 9 Battle Campaign[/b], starting Aptil 5th!
	This Season, [b]Parts Fragment[/b] will be added to Battle Pass rewards.
    
	[h1]The Battle Campaign[/h1]	The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period. Different rewards can be earned depending on the number of Battle Cards a player has collected. There are over 100 rewards available, and many of the various items needed to improve robots can be obtained.

	You can check the Battle Campaign rewards and the number of Battle Cards you have earned by clicking the "Battle Pass" button on the lobby screen or by pressing F5.
	
		[b]Season 9 Battle Campaign Rewards[/b]	　
	[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/10404]Please click HERE for details regarding the reward lineup[/url]. 
	
	[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1]	[b]250,700,1300 Card Prize: A-ALS Select Box[/b]
	This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate Avalanche Sword. The Alternate are Limited Edition weapons with the same functionality as the Avalanche Sword, but with a special look that can only be obtained here!

		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3d99b1768b19db96eb53aa5bb14aba3a90c38d5d.png[/img]
	　
	[b]550 Card Prize: Tsukishiro Kanna Hkm[/b]
	[Tsukishiro Kanna] in a special hakama outfit!
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/253467d24baf88ce528b9f7f24852f114d13eb97.png[/img]
	　
	[b]Campaign Period[/b]	　
	From 04/05/2023 (JST) until 07/05/2023 (JST).
	*A battle campaign will be held each season, with each season lasting three months.
	　
	[h1]About the Battle Pass[/h1]	The special reward slots in the active Battle Campaign will be exclusively accessible to Battle Pass owners. The special reward slots will offer a variety of unique prizes in addition to the normal rewards!
	　
	[b]How to Get a Battle Pass[/b]
	A Battle Pass can be purchased from the in-game Shop in the "ITEM" section for 300 Rt. Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on "Charge Rt".

	*You can still receive rewards even if you purchase the Battle Pass after a Season has started.	

	[b]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/b]	
	All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.

       	
	
	[b]How to Get Battle Cards[/b]	
	Battle Cards can be obtained based on wins, losses, and battle results in valid Union Wars rooms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/fd5cea278cc40c29246d61bf2c93861138120542.jpg[/img]
	*The amount of cards that can be earned from a match varies depending on the conditions set for the room. Please see the chart below for additional details.	
	
	[b]Breakdown of Cards Earned[/b]	
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/a9222025b5a97f4595cf20fc0dfd8ad85ae2b9a5.jpg[/img]
	*Players whose consumed BP has reached more than 6,500 will not receive cards.
	*Players who join in the middle of a match will not receive cards.
		
	[b]Rewards for Actions[/b]	
	Players will be awarded at the end of matches based on the actions they took during the match. Depending on the number of participants in the match, the top players in the ranking of each award will get 1 additional Battle Card each.

	*The amount of players who can receive an additional reward will vary depending on the number of participants in a match.

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/4637ebb19bdc464ed3e13b95fcccef6af9b38dfe.jpg[/img]
	*There must be at least 14 players participating in the match in order to earn additional rewards.
	*Additional cards cannot be earned if a player has won a match, as they are already at the earnable limit.
	
	[b]Please Note:[/b]
	-Battle Cards will be removed at the end of the Season.

・Jumbo Bomb Bombs will jump forward immediately after placement.

notes.title: Season 8 Battle Campaign
notes.content:
[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/9428]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/82209537cf36a4143fc0f961508d210d016d334a.jpg[/img]
[/url]
	
	Throw yourself into the thrill of battle in the Union Wars and receive a variety of unique items during the [b]Season 8 Battle Campaign[/b], starting January 11th!
	
	[h1]The Battle Campaign[/h1]	The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period. Different rewards can be earned depending on the number of Battle Cards a player has collected. There are over 100 rewards available, and many of the various items needed to improve robots can be obtained.

	You can check the Battle Campaign rewards and the number of Battle Cards you have earned by clicking the "Battle Pass" button on the lobby screen or by pressing F5.
	
		[b]Season 8 Battle Campaign Rewards[/b]	　
	[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/9428]Please click HERE for details regarding the reward lineup[/url]. 
	
	[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1]	[b]250,700,1300 Card Prize: A-BMG Select Box[/b]
	This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate B Machinegun. The Alternate B Machinegun are Limited Edition weapons with the same functionality as the Beam Machinegun, but with a special look that can only be obtained here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/0c8eb9d03f2a7c8144bf37cecc0bc297d4d9ecee.png[/img]
	　
	[b]550 Card Prize: Monica Gold Bike[/b]
	A special Monica Gold riding a motorbike!
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/9c81804e863793dea9780483af39ae3bcacd9c44.png[/img]
	　
	[b]Campaign Period[/b]	　
	From 1/11/2023 (JST) until 4/5/2023 (JST).
	*A battle campaign will be held each season, with each season lasting three months.
	　
	[h1]About the Battle Pass[/h1]	The special reward slots in the active Battle Campaign will be exclusively accessible to Battle Pass owners. The special reward slots will offer a variety of unique prizes in addition to the normal rewards!
	　
	[b]How to Get a Battle Pass[/b]
	A Battle Pass can be purchased from the in-game Shop in the "ITEM" section for 300 Rt. Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on "Charge Rt".

	*You can still receive rewards even if you purchase the Battle Pass after a Season has started.	

	[b]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/b]	
	All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/fd5cea278cc40c29246d61bf2c93861138120542.jpg[/img]

	[b]How to Get Battle Cards[/b]	
	Battle Cards can be obtained based on wins, losses, and battle results in valid Union Wars rooms.

	*The amount of cards that can be earned from a match varies depending on the conditions set for the room. Please see the chart below for additional details.	
	
	[b]Breakdown of Cards Earned[/b]	
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/a9222025b5a97f4595cf20fc0dfd8ad85ae2b9a5.jpg[/img]
        *In order to get cards, at least 10 players must be participating in the match.
	*Players whose consumed BP has reached more than 6,500 will not receive cards.
	*Players who join in the middle of a match will not receive cards.
		
	[b]Rewards for Actions[/b]	
	Players will be awarded at the end of matches based on the actions they took during the match. Depending on the number of participants in the match, the top players in the ranking of each award will get 1 additional Battle Card each.

	*The amount of players who can receive an additional reward will vary depending on the number of participants in a match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/4637ebb19bdc464ed3e13b95fcccef6af9b38dfe.jpg[/img]	
	*There must be at least 14 players participating in the match in order to earn additional rewards.
	*Additional cards cannot be earned if a player has won a match, as they are already at the earnable limit.
	
	[b]Please Note:[/b]
	-Battle Cards will be removed at the end of the Season.

notes.title: Welcome to the Halloween Event [Stein's Lab] !
notes.content:
After the maintenance on 10/25/2022 JST the Halloween event [Stein's Lab] was available from the [Event Space] where players can travel to various planets.

During the event period, players will be able to travel to Thermes Stein's Lab!
This is where players will be able to undertake the quest.

[h2]◆What is Stein's Lab?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/83441b3db342b5a21319986f402aafe97858852f.png[/img]
In Stein's Lab players will be assaulted by various Halloween flavored enemies, like ghosts?!

Thermes is a crazed scientist pursuing the nature of life, and regularly immerses herself in dubious experiements.
After hearing some frighteneing rumors, you decide to investigate the laboratory.
Suddenly, a frankensteined robot appears?!
It looks like a weakling, so go for its weak points!
What could be waiting for the doctor in the depths of the lab...

Defeat the lab's boss to earn [b] Halloween styled accessories and parts[/b]!
Dress up your favorite robots for Halloween and enjoy a Trick or Treat!

[h2]◆What is the Event Area?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/cd99a26b6a2544e47a405fe12ce65a9bf9171a21.png[/img]
By going to the Event Space, you can find a quest to go to other various Stars for a limited time.Challenge the quests at the event space to get special accessories and parts from the planet of your choosing.
[img][/img]- Parts and Accessories from Stein's Lab
( Devil Nina & Devil Thermes, Eligos Wing, Halloween Spook, Gale Scythe O, Hazard Victory)
Look forward to many other parts and accessories as well!

Players will require an Event Ticket to go to the Event Area for this quest.
To celebrate the launch of this event, we will be offering [b]Event Entry Tickets for a limited time[/b]!イベンTickets can be recieved by logging in once per day during the event, so don't miss out!

[h3]Event Entry Period [/h3]
After maintenance 10/25/2022 JST
Until maintenance 11/12/2022 JST

[h2]◆How to Access the Event Area[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/1ccb38b68a5f13b6eddc64f5aab0018afbc7def2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/d5d6bd02d68f5529ddf3dc80f84c8cad460a1aed.png[/img][/url]1. Head to the Ground Area.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/c282af679d82a828e4035c5f68488b29b78dec38.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/77e17868e02e72e13226e6ed8d07484ca892ac34.jpg[/img][/url]2. In the Ground Area, press F3 or click the QUEST button on your screen!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/fabd959d02593373a1efa1ef4be22f0a1f380390.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/96172c87557aba1929c3fbf9ef8d3f98cbf7fc66.jpg[/img][/url]3. When the quest Room Creation screen appears, Create a Room, select Event Space, and then select Stein's Lab!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/d341b08d27bf15891f7dea3c9d873cd6a3447bc0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/fcf3388479562cbb801b75dac74540a5ec7fb81a.jpg[/img][/url]4.Finally, select [Start Alone] to challenge Stein's Lab!

The Stein's Lab quest will not fail even if a character is defeated.
The battle area is randomized, so don't get spooked in this haunted labyrinth!



[h2]◆Halloween Garapon Added![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/6fbd464fe8f44cf4b04d4806b9f867e7a636414f.png[/img]

notes.title: Season 7 Battle Campaign
notes.content:
[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/8301]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/4c1e3fc6e499ef4d7efc38452df1047fbaea3416.jpg[/img]
[/url]
	Throw yourself into the thrill of battle in the Union Wars and receive a variety of unique items during the [b]Season 7 Battle Campaign[/b], starting October 5th!
	This Season, [b]Event Entry[/b] will be added to Battle Pass rewards.
    
	[h1]The Battle Campaign[/h1]	The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period. Different rewards can be earned depending on the number of Battle Cards a player has collected. There are over 100 rewards available, and many of the various items needed to improve robots can be obtained.

	You can check the Battle Campaign rewards and the number of Battle Cards you have earned by clicking the "Battle Pass" button on the lobby screen or by pressing F5.
	
		[b]Season 7 Battle Campaign Rewards[/b]	　
	[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/8301]Please click HERE for details regarding the reward lineup.[/url] 
	
	[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1]	[b]250,700,1300 Card Prize: A-BBZ Select Box[/b]
	This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate B Bazooka. The Alternate B Bazooka are Limited Edition weapons with the same functionality as the Blast Bazooka, but with a special look that can only be obtained here!

		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/bb742ca4fd09e21cd1d102d022c7c174a6d6ded4.png[/img]
	　
	[b]550 Card Prize: Homura Swm[/b]
	Homura dressed in special swim attire!
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/d50583315b965876956db6adbe4f8a2d17ad7b96.png[/img]
	　
	[b]Campaign Period[/b]	　
	From 10/5/2022 (JST) until 1/11/2023 (JST).
	*A battle campaign will be held each season, with each season lasting three months.
	　
	[h1]About the Battle Pass[/h1]	The special reward slots in the active Battle Campaign will be exclusively accessible to Battle Pass owners. The special reward slots will offer a variety of unique prizes in addition to the normal rewards!
	　
	[b]How to Get a Battle Pass[/b]
	A Battle Pass can be purchased from the in-game Shop in the "ITEM" section for 300 Rt. Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on "Charge Rt".

	*You can still receive rewards even if you purchase the Battle Pass after a Season has started.	

	[b]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/b]	
	All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/fd5cea278cc40c29246d61bf2c93861138120542.jpg[/img]
	
	[b]How to Get Battle Cards[/b]	
	Battle Cards can be obtained based on wins, losses, and battle results in valid Union Wars rooms.

	*The amount of cards that can be earned from a match varies depending on the conditions set for the room. Please see the chart below for additional details.	
	
	[b]Breakdown of Cards Earned[/b]	
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/a9222025b5a97f4595cf20fc0dfd8ad85ae2b9a5.jpg[/img]
	*Players whose consumed BP has reached more than 6,500 will not receive cards.
	*Players who join in the middle of a match will not receive cards.
		
	[b]Rewards for Actions[/b]	
	Players will be awarded at the end of matches based on the actions they took during the match. Depending on the number of participants in the match, the top players in the ranking of each award will get 1 additional Battle Card each.

	*The amount of players who can receive an additional reward will vary depending on the number of participants in a match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ff9f7a0f02fa1b7fd46c31936fbc6dd20d2f0034.jpg[/img]	
	*There must be at least 14 players participating in the match in order to earn additional rewards.
	*Additional cards cannot be earned if a player has won a match, as they are already at the earnable limit.
	
	[b]Please Note:[/b]
	-Battle Cards will be removed at the end of the Season.

notes.title: Chibi Union Wars：Bomb and Destroy Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/c2d373919e63f651c28f0d0ce31b8cbd97b55dc8.png[/img]
	
[h1]What is the Chibi Union Wars：Bomb and Destroy?[/h1]	A special edition of the Chibi Union Wars, battles limited to Chibi characters!
	Players will now be able to look for the tremendously powerful Bombs in the chibi character Union Wars!
	The damage caused by Bombs will be extravagant, and may even take out your enemies with one shot!
	Take your favorite chibi characters on an explosively fun mission in Union Wars Bomb and Destroy!
	
	[h2]Bomb[/h2]	There are four types of Bombs in total.
	・Bomb Bombs can be installed directly in-place.
	・Dash Bomb Bombs will move directly forward after placement.
	・Jumbo Bomb Bombs will jump forward immediately after placement.
	・Anti Gravity Bombs will create a force field keeping enemies from getting too close for a period of time.
	
	Each type of bomb will be randomly and continually generated by Bomb Pots on the stage.
	Each team has a Bomb Pot, and players can obtain Bombs from their own team's Pot repeatedly. Players can only obtain Bombs from the enemy's Pot periodically.
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/72a5895d29917ffb556b657a8d793251f55074f1.png[/img]
	
	[h2]Availability[/h2]	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/bd322b6dc9827b99f9a1d6417d94dd2606b1e5df.jpg[/img]
	[h2]Rewards[/h2]	This time players can find Homura-chan and big Ion-chan as prizes!
	Chibi Character prizes from previous Union Wars can also be won with a set probability.
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3dd397e8b9c1b9ca9ba51654179069dad672833b.png[/img]
	
	
		
	Thank you for your support of CosmicBreak Universal!

notes.title: Season 6 Battle Campaign
notes.content:
[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/7146]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/51a8e6c2045b93a99750172c8e930418ba23f491.jpg[/img][/url]
	
	Throw yourself into the thrill of battle in the Union Wars and receive a variety of unique items during the [b]Season 6 Battle Campaign[/b], starting July 6th!	
	
	[h1]The Battle Campaign[/h1]	The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period. Different rewards can be earned depending on the number of Battle Cards a player has collected. There are over 100 rewards available, and many of the various items needed to improve robots can be obtained.

	You can check the Battle Campaign rewards and the number of Battle Cards you have earned by clicking the "Battle Pass" button on the lobby screen or by pressing F5.
	
		[b]Season 6 Battle Campaign Rewards[/b]	　
	[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/7146]Please click HERE for details regarding the reward lineup[/url]. 
	
	[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1]	[b]250,700,1300 Card Prize: A-RRF Select Box[/b]
	This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate Raid Rifle. The Alternate Raid Rifle are Limited Edition weapons with the same functionality as the Raid Rifle, but with a special look that can only be obtained here!

		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/47312655baaed6510f3c61907abbf262d29d1238.png[/img]
	　
	[b]400 Card Prize: Minaria Swm[/b]
	Minaria has ripped off her gloomy dress and donned a bikini to embrace the summer!
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/7bb6a5a5e6e394c1c760ce3dc37f169ef59ab181.png[/img]
	　
	[b]1000 Card Prize: Colleti Swm[/b]
	Colleti has ripped off her gloomy dress and donned a bikini to embrace the summer!
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/0d8844ebfa66dc4c8c37aec088579cc9b37a714d.png[/img]
	　
	[b]Campaign Period[/b]	　
	From 7/6/2022 (JST) until 10/5/2022 (JST).
	*A battle campaign will be held each season, with each season lasting three months.
	　
	[h1]About the Battle Pass[/h1]	The special reward slots in the active Battle Campaign will be exclusively accessible to Battle Pass owners. The special reward slots will offer a variety of unique prizes in addition to the normal rewards!
	　
	[b]How to Get a Battle Pass[/b]
	A Battle Pass can be purchased from the in-game Shop in the "ITEM" section for 300 Rt. Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on "Charge Rt".

	*You can still receive rewards even if you purchase the Battle Pass after a Season has started.	

	[b]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/b]	
	All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/09b4473ca592c3b164f1cfb525ebf7fea6ee174c.jpg[/img]
	[b]How to Get Battle Cards[/b]	
	Battle Cards can be obtained based on wins, losses, and battle results in valid Union Wars rooms.

	*The amount of cards that can be earned from a match varies depending on the conditions set for the room. Please see the chart below for additional details.	
	
	[b]Breakdown of Cards Earned[/b]	
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/f4be22ddc52dbe7247960458f6b8d6d442b1cacb.jpg[/img]	*In order to get cards, at least 10 players must be participating in the match.
	*Players whose consumed BP has reached more than 6,500 will not receive cards.
	*Players who join in the middle of a match will not receive cards.
		
	[b]Rewards for Actions[/b]	
	Players will be awarded at the end of matches based on the actions they took during the match. Depending on the number of participants in the match, the top players in the ranking of each award will get 1 additional Battle Card each.

	*The amount of players who can receive an additional reward will vary depending on the number of participants in a match.

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/d6fb55d5bc24d42493949072d937cb412c84a856.jpg[/img]	*There must be at least 14 players participating in the match in order to earn additional rewards.
	*Additional cards cannot be earned if a player has won a match, as they are already at the earnable limit.
	
	[b]Please Note:[/b]
	-Battle Cards will be removed at the end of the Season.

notes.title: 3rd Large-Scale Battle Campaign Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/6571f0e858dca04c91e186c7058c170ea7d1355a.png[/img]

The 3 Guardians have decided to prepare a [b]grand new arena for a large number of heroes[/b] to battle in order to collect more Cosmos! 	

[b]50 vs 50[/b] battles can take place in this new arena!	
Players can receive [b]Cosmo Harmonics[/b] by participating.

[b]Prepare for the fiercest battle you've ever experienced in the Arena![/b]	
  
[h2]Event Period[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/1d5a18592aed71022121365bf55849179533d36f.png[/img][h2]Event Details[/h2][b]A large-scale 50 vs 50 Battle Campaign will be held![/b]	
Throughout the event period, [b]a new Union Wars [50vs50] option will be added to the Event Battle section of the Arena[/b]. 
  
  The main objective in Large-Scale Battles is to bring the enemy team's BP down to 0, which can be done most effectively [b]by destroying the enemy team's 5 Power Spots.[/b]	
  [b]Destroying a Power Spot will reduce the enemy team's BP by 20%, so be sure to attack them whenever possible![/b] Furthermore, [b]each team will have 1 large Power Spot worth 30% of the team BP, so don't miss any chances to destroy it![/b]
   	
  Finally, there will also be [b]a mounted turret[/b] available in Large-Scale Battle stages, perfect for wreaking havoc on your enemies!	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/850dc0a243e9ef84628e139c72dd52d8a1765999.png[/img]
  
Receive [b]Cosmo Harmonics 10%[/b] by participating in a match! You can also receive additional items like [b]Cosmo Harmonics 20% and Cosmo Harmonics 10%[/b] at random. Furthermore, you can receive [b]more Coins than you would from a standard Union Wars battle![/b]

You can participate as many times as you'd like during the event's active hours, so collect all of the items you need!
  
The following rules will be active in Rooms for this event.
-During the event's active hours, 3 Rooms will be added to the Event Battles section.	
-A match will not begin if the number of participants in a Room is below 60 players.	
-The waiting for match state will automatically be removed after a match.

notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary Celebration!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/0bbbe448391c0e5f3284600e3b201c48b0c08b69.jpg[/img]
	
	Thanks to all of you players, CosmicBreak Universal is able to celebrate its 1 year anniversary!
	We'll be holding a number of great events to commemorate!
	
	[h1]■ CBUNI Campaign Election 2022[/h1]	In honor of our first year anniversary, CBUNI will hold an election for our next representative girl!
	Players will be able to select one of the girls that has been enetered into the game so far to serve as the rep for future CBUNI content!
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/4db1b0556e15a255d89f69b66d36819fb962e750.jpg[/img]
	
	Elections will be held throughout season 5.
	Elections will be held using the [Voting Ticket] in the [Voting Set] which can be obtained by completing various game modes.
	Please speak to the [Election Personnel] NPC in the resort Area to cast your vote.
	
	[b]Voting Location[/b]
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/a689607bc6cf6f94ebfc9c3d2d381e952459e034.png[/img]
	
	[b]Election Schedule[/b]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/aaa5234611b981f54611478db038f07551123ae8.png[/img]
	[h3]Preliminary[/h3]	In the prelims, a total of 75 candidates will be added into voting blocks of 5 candidates each.
	Each block (A block, B block, C block, D block, E block) has a corresponding Vote Ticket. (Example: A Block voting ticket → Vote Ticket A)
	Opening the [Voting Set] will give players access to the Vote Tickets for each block.
	The top 6 characters of each block will be selected to advance to the next round!
	Look for which characters are featured in each block in-game!
	
	
	[h3]Main[/h3]	In the main competition players will have the chance to vote for each block.
	The 30 characters who won the prelim round will be assigned to one of three blocks, for a total of 10 characters in each block.
	The same as in the prelims, players can cast their vote with [Vote Tickets] available from [Voting Sets].
	A total of 12 characters, 4 from each block, willl advance to the final round!
	
	[h3]Final[/h3]	The final round will not divide characters into blocks, and two will be selected as the winners!
	The top two characters selected will then face off in a Faction Batle!
	
	Sign up for the faction of the character you want to win and propel them to victory!
	
	<font color="red">※All unused Voting Tickets and unopened Voting Sets will be removed after the voting period ends.
	※Voting completion certificates that are granted automatically after casting one's vote will not be removed.</font>
	
	
		
	[h1]■ 1 Year Challenge Cube[/h1]	To commemorate the 1 year anniversary, we will sell Anniversary Cubes where players can get amazing rewards!
	Like the challenge cube, players can obtain items by fulfilling the conditions within.
	Complete all of the conditions within to get one Gold or Silver Garapon character from the previous year![/b]
	Plenty of the rewards are exclusive, so don't miss out on this chance!
	
	[h3]What is a Challenge Cube?[/h3]	Challenge Cubes present conditions that players can clear to obtain great rewards.
	Clear the challenges ahead and collect your prizes!
	
	[h3]Anniversary Cube Prizes[/h3]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/e0a8160e3b6ef5f43d729f421d03b702ae00017f.png[/img]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/b6924db32d208b7ee122221db7354101a1c02631.png[/img]
	
	[h2]What's an SDX Coin?[/h2]	This coin can be exchanged for Gold and Silver Tier Garapon Characters that have appeared in the prior year.
	They can be used at the Central Area SDX Coin Exchange.
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/26fb893ae7b8bec9dd12b4140f77722e3836a5f1.png[/img]
	
	[h3]Anniversary Cube Price[/h3]	150Rt
	・Can be purchased a the in-game Shop.
	<font color="red">※Limited to one purchase per person.</font>
	
	[h3]Sale and Prize Availability Period[/h3]	After maintenace 4/6/2022 JST
	Until 07:00 7/6/2022 JST
	
	※You can check the current progress of Prize conditions in the Profile Page of the Garage.
	※After fulfilling the conditions, prizes can be obtained from the Profile Page of the Garage as well.
	※Please note that once the effect has been cancelled, the prizes can no longer be obtained.
	
	
		
	[h1]■ 1 Year Anniversary Orders[/h1]	A limited first anniversary Order will be available as well where players can receive great rewards!
	Challenge the Anniversary Order by logging in during the event period, and by achieving the conditions, where you can get rewards with an Anniversary motif!
	Don't miss this chance!
	
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/c5c3b7f54f829b2e2c31f292a597b1fbd7e1ca72.png[/img]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/6c5d8030065fc44e0fdcc04de0e62d70d5a191c0.png[/img]
	
	
		
	[h1]■ Robot Garapon Lineup Added![/h1]	New characters will be permanently added to the Robot Garapon!	[h3]Added Character List[/h3]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/a140f4386a8135bcba14471a66d97132ee58fd8e.png[/img]	
	
		
	[h1]■ Union Coin Exchange Prizes Added![/h1]	In commemoration of our 1st Anniversary, we will be adding new prizes to the Union Coin Exchange!
	Each Union will heave unique prizes!
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3bb4e6ffce1264e5cc98115eb17386703f40bde0.png[/img]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/c5af6637caab3357955c5d9a8ec6e476a0818a21.png[/img]

	Thank you for your support of CosmicBreak Universal!

By completing the Pritzl Disk 1 offers, players can get Pritzl Disk 2.
Also, by completing the Pritzl Disk 2 offers, players can get Pritzl Disk 3.
Complete the Pritzl Disk 3 offers to get [Pritzl Bouncer].

[Brisgandr Disk 1] has the same specifications, and by completing them all players can get the [Brisgandr Detective] title!
Additional prizes can also be won by completing all of the above disks!

- Choosing [Normal Material] will return Tune-Up materials and UC without consuming the Cosmo Regret OMEGA.
- Choosing [Compensation Material] will return the material linked to the specific Tune-Up. Using this item in a Tune-Up grants it a 100% success rate.
Example: Choose a [Compensation Material] for a [High Power]  tune-up to receive a [High Power] tune-up material.
※Target parts for compensation include all parts.
※Tune ups can be cancelled to receive compensation materials up to a total of 100 times.
※Compansation materials can be collected until 10:00 3/2/2022 JST.

Thank you for your support of CosmicBreak Universal!

notes.title: Season 4 Begins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/bc33a3387067709c899eef7a6ba281b1fbb2c9fd.jpg[/img]	
	Season 4 of CosmicBreak Universal has begun as of Wednesday, 1/12/2022 (UTC).
