notes.title: Season 4 Battle Campaign
notes.content:
[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/5825]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/60f5442fefaa581c90747399bd5ec15517f78611.jpg[/img][/url]
	
	Throw yourself into the thrill of battle in the Union Wars and receive a variety of unique items during the [b]Season 4 Battle Campaign[/b], starting January 12th!	
	
	[h1]The Battle Campaign[/h1]	The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period. Different rewards can be earned depending on the number of Battle Cards a player has collected. There are over 100 rewards available, and many of the various items needed to improve robots can be obtained.

	You can check the Battle Campaign rewards and the number of Battle Cards you have earned by clicking the "Battle Pass" button on the lobby screen or by pressing F5.
	
		[b]Season 4 Battle Campaign Rewards[/b]	　
	[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/5825]Please click HERE for details regarding the reward lineup[/url]. 
	
	[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1]	[b]250,700,1300 Card Prize: A-PBR Select Box[/b]
	This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate Pierce Breaker. The Alternate Pierce Breaker are Limited Edition weapons with the same functionality as the Pierce Breaker, but with a special look that can only be obtained here!

		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ec02fbd5f342244521e813d0123d4224a2034b53.png[/img]
	　
	[b]400 Card Prize: Lisel Fml[/b]
	A special costume featuring Lisel Zweig in full dress uniform!
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/f1e18d21ca05b2c7464990d2cc05de40f8045fee.png[/img]
	　
	[b]1000 Card Prize: Kuhl Fml[/b]
	A special costume featuring Kuhl in full dress uniform!
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/23fdcae2b88179ccb32f61606cfe0f98d154e5b2.png[/img]
	　
	[b]Campaign Period[/b]	　
	From 1/12/2022 (JST) until 4/6/2022 (JST).
	*A battle campaign will be held each season, with each season lasting three months.
	　
	[h1]About the Battle Pass[/h1]	The special reward slots in the active Battle Campaign will be exclusively accessible to Battle Pass owners. The special reward slots will offer a variety of unique prizes in addition to the normal rewards!
	　
	[b]How to Get a Battle Pass[/b]
	A Battle Pass can be purchased from the in-game Shop in the "ITEM" section for 300 Rt. Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on "Charge Rt".

	*You can still receive rewards even if you purchase the Battle Pass after a Season has started.	

	[b]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/b]	
	All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ddcec6d9bcf226c290c7689e2d8ced4bbb3e43e5.png[/img]	
	[b]How to Get Battle Cards[/b]	
	Battle Cards can be obtained based on wins, losses, and battle results in valid Union Wars rooms.

	*The amount of cards that can be earned from a match varies depending on the conditions set for the room. Please see the chart below for additional details.	
	
	[b]Breakdown of Cards Earned[/b]	
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3b319bf47ac0c462a0b0fb41816c0c9f34e69666.png[/img]	*In order to get cards, at least 10 players must be participating in the match.
	*Players whose consumed BP has reached more than 6,500 will not receive cards.
	*Players who join in the middle of a match will not receive cards.
		
	[b]Rewards for Actions[/b]	
	Players will be awarded at the end of matches based on the actions they took during the match. Depending on the number of participants in the match, the top players in the ranking of each award will get 1 additional Battle Card each.

	*The amount of players who can receive an additional reward will vary depending on the number of participants in a match.

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ad18681cd8ee7f2678c89b6fdcc1abfdb648aa35.png[/img]	*There must be at least 14 players participating in the match in order to earn additional rewards.
	*Additional cards cannot be earned if a player has won a match, as they are already at the earnable limit.
	
	[b]Please Note:[/b]
	-Battle Cards will be removed at the end of the Season.

notes.title: [Cosmic Break GUN & SLASH] now on sale on Steam!
notes.content:
Greetings from the Cosmic Break Universal service team.

Cyberstep Co., Ltd. is pleased to announce that [CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH], a spin-off work of the MMO battle shooting game [CosmicBreak], was released on Steam December 23, 2021, for 1,990 JPY. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/6e1a2f05c9f74046d9a713888c325ef0e4bad8d8.png[/img]

The [CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH] store page can be found here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1815020/


[h1]What is [CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH]?[/h1]

[Cosmic Break GUN & SLASH] is a spin-off work of [Cosmic Break], an MMO battle shooting game in featuring robots and humanoids, active since 2008.

Set in the world of CosmicBreak, Gun & Slash is a top-down hack and slasher where players can control popular characters such as Zero Saber and Zero Saber Girl to defeat hordes of enemies!


[h1][CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH] Features[/h1]

[h3]◆Charming characters![/h3]
Unlock and control 12 of the most popular characters from "CosmicBreak Universal"!
Characters will be released based on the number of stages you complete in Main Mode and your clear time!

[h3]◆Use your weapons to defeat the enemy![/h3]
Characters can equip up to two weapons, and each weapon has a Main Weapon and a Sub Weapon.
Switch between up to four weapons in your quest for victory!
Weapons are randomly dropped during the game in Main Mode.
Collect various weapons and skills and aim for victory!

[h3]◆Compete for the best record![/h3]
This game features a Main Mode, where players aim to defeat enemies or clear maps, a Time Attack Mode where they can compete for best clear time with players the world over, and a Challenge Mode, where players compete for longest survival time!
Time Attack Mode and Challenge Mode are compatible with Steam leaderboards.
Compete with players from all over the world to become a top ranker!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/46716f6ec8b976865c5e8a80f7e507f7dedca934.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3fb0f9e2f4ba10145b881e01a01b02069abc0a1f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/db3df14a767653902599e3cf476df319832d3b85.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/cf184dbb391818380ea44a7d99c1df6656e2b916.jpg[/img]
*Images are taken during development and may differ from the final product.


[h2]◆Service Details[/h2]

Title: [Cosmic Break GUN & SLASH] 
Genre: Hack and Slash
Play Type: Single Player
Platform: PC(Steam)
Release Date: 12/23/2021 JST
Cost: 1,990 JPY
Available Languages: Japanese/English/Chinese (Traditional)

Thank you for your support of [CosmicBreak GUN & SLASH] and [CosmicBreak Universal]!

There's no better time to challenge this mission!

[h3]Event Period[/h3]From after maintenance, 11/10/2021 JST
Until maintenance 11/17/2021 JST



[h1]Epoch Battle Adjustments[/h1]Epoch Battles have been adjusted in accordance with the results of the Epoch Battle Renovation Event.

[h2]◆Rule Adjustments[/h2][h3]Basic Rules[/h3]・The match time limits are 5 minutes (up to a maximum of 7.)
・Attacker Victory Condition: Destroy Defender's Power Spot 3 times within the time limit.
・Defender Victory Condition: Protect Power Spot for the duration of the time limit.

Each time a power spot is destroyed, the match time will be extended by 1 minute. (Maximum +2 minutes)
The BP of the attacking side will decrease automatically beginning 1 min after battle commences.
The time limit and BP are linked, and when the time limit reaches 0, the BP also becomes 0, and the Attacking team loses.

[h3]Power Spot[/h3]・Player origin HP recovery will not work on power spots.

[h3]Others[/h3]・Amended so that the entire field can be viewed when pening the map.
・Amended so that the HP of the Power Spot is displayed at the top of the screen.
・Amended the HP of the Attacker's Power Spot to also be displayed.
・Amended so that the Power Spots are marked with letters to make understanding Power Spot damage simpler.

[h2]◆Stage Adjustments[/h2]The terrain of each stage has been altered.


[h2]Union Coin +1 Campaign[/h2]Participate in Epoch Battles to receive extra Union Coin rewards!
Don't miss this chance to collect prizes!

[h3]Event Period[/h3]From after maintenance, 11/10/2021 JST
Until maintenance 11/17/2021 JST



[h3]■ Bug Fixes[/h3]・Fixed a bug that caused parts to be destroyed even though tune-up was not possible for Lisel Gatling.

・Fixed a bug concerning the additional damage caused by the markings of Axion AM3 and AM4, which caused unintended death effects that consumed twice the amount of BP.

・Fixed a bug where the cool time did not occur when using Lily EVE  BD "MAGICAL CIRCLE" after using "E.V.E." of Lily EVE HD for Lily EVE-chan.

・Fixed a bug in Lily Rain Eve α that caused the game to stop working properly when using Wonderbit while in a vehicle.

・Fixed a bug in the shop where the number of slots on the Tierouge AMJ was not as intended.
- After this bug is fixed, characters equipped with 3-slot Tierouge AMJ will no longer be able to sortie.
*Players who purchased the Tierouge AMJ during the period from maintenance on November 2, 2021 to today's maintenance will be sent a 1-slot Tirouge AMJ and Cosmo Regret OMEGA .
We deeply apologize the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.



[h3]■ Others[/h3]・Some animations have been changed for Crim-chan's "MAGICAL CIRCLE" .

・On November 17th, we will make the following balance adjustments for "VOLT IMPACT" for Model No. 131.
- Lock On Number：3 → 1
※We feel it is a requirement to limit the number of characters onto which the VOLT IMPACT can lock, as in 30vs30 battle situations it would become too easy for a single character to immobilize players and decrease overall satisfaction with the fighting situation.



Thank you for your support of CosmicBreak Universal.

notes.title: Welcome to the Halloween World, the Vampyre Star!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/fc17929bff1d3011123063bb7d93d4145e365dcc.png[/img]
CosmicBreak Universal Season 3 began on October 6, 2021.
With the release of the new season comes a new Event Space, where players can travel to various planets in the Cosmic Star System.

From the Event Area, players can go to the [b]Halloween planet, the Vampyre Star[/b]!
Read on for an introduction of the Vampyre Star!


[h1]◆What is the Vampyre Star?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/e3f41c43f9e83e57d43816623e55baebe6fecd80.png[/img]
－The Vampyre Star features Halloween themed characters and items!


The Vampyre Star is [b] a planet inhabited by monsters in the shape of ghosts and bats [/ b].
Maybe these Halloween creatures want to play a little Trick or Treat?
They're not the strongest monsters, so play a little trick on them with confidence!

Defeat the planet's bosses to get [b] Halloween-themed accessories and parts! [/ b]
Get the perfect Halloween look for your character!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/8fe394d4bf9a5bf7179eaa7a973e9bd4a0362c3e.png[/img]
－Parts and Accessories on the Vampyre Star
(Jack-O-Launcher, Nekomimi Robe HW, Devil Liru & Devil Amlim, Ghost Shooter, Coffin Bat Gun)


[h1]◆What is the Event Area?[/h1]
By going to the Event Space, you can find a quest to go to other various Stars for a limited time.
Challenge the quests at the event space to get special accessories and parts from the planet of your choosing.

In addition, in order to challenge the event space, you will need a special [Event Entry] ticket sold in the shop.
To commemorate the appearance of the Vampyre Star, players can get Event Entry tickets for a limited time [b] [/ b]! Event entry tickets can be received once a day at login, so don't miss this opportunity!

[h3]Event Entry Present Period[/h3]
After maintenance 10/6/2021 JST
Until maintenance 11/3/2021 JST


[h2]◆How to go to the Event Area[/h2]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/7c63a15919f8fe9d50b0cecc8e5a1175f3d7e21f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/495527d9b7277613586654a62c0f460c31740077.png[/img][/url]1. Go to the Ground Area in-game.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/6f778eff7f7f52a73081014076a82a5c93888679.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ab1cd2598e772767cc9424c0fa891eca1382e733.png[/img][/url]2. When you reach the Ground Area, press F3 or click the "QUEST" button on the screen.
"[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/25e33f890eab93710b39bb77108bdad9e950e3a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/2ddacfe7b000bb8bfde620dec67560a8a41baaaa.png[/img][/url]
3. When the Quest Room creation screen is displayed, select the Event Space and choose the planet to visit!"
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/fd213899e794f0794f4ac4217c37d6bcd432990a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/5546e5110eeaa3704be95f48d1f0ed0265ea67de.png[/img][/url]4. Finally, spend your Event Entry ticket to challenge the planet of your choice!

In addition, even if your character is defeated in the Event Space, you won't fail the quest.
Defeat as many enemies as you can in the limited quest time!



[h1]◆Garapon No.7 [/h1][url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/4618][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/75b3528de93639e4b89d68f0c5eaf9c3b8366461.jpg[/img][/url]
Garapon No. 7, where you can get the characters from the Vampyre Star System, has been added!
The lineup includes many [b] Halloween-themed characters and robots [/ b]!
This Garapon is only here for a limited time, so don't miss this chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/20346326c6445dfaeeef90d78a15948626dc3b8c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/99aa0dc7df4f74005e7e789371d04a2ece51914d.png[/img]
[h3]Garapon Period[/h3]
After maintenance 10/6/2021 JST
Until maintenance 12/1/2021 JST

[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/4618]Garapon No.7 Details Here[/url]

notes.title: Teravit Global Alpha Test Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings CosmicBreak Universal players!

We would like to announce that [b]the Global Alpha Test for CyberStep's latest title "Teravit" will be available[/b] from October 12th, 2021 15:00 (JST)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/e51d99c9a31addae35c045943181eecf3993ef1e.png[/img]

For the Global Alpha Test, voxel avatars can now be applied in Teravit.
Included with the voxel avatars provided by Teravit is [b]CosmicBreak Universal's Crimrose![/b] 
Let's explore the world of Teravit using Crimrose's avatar!



[h2]What is Teravit?[/h2]Teravit is a multiplayer, open-world sandbox RPG that gives you the freedom to explore and adventure in a vast and diverse fantasy voxel world.

https://www.youtube.com/embed/NgQEmBPqcHI
- Teravit Store Page
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1743650/Teravit/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1743650/Teravit/[/url]


[h2]Exploring as Crimrose!? Create your own voxel avatar![/h2]During Teravit's Global Alpha Test, you will be able to edit your player character's avatar!

[h3]Let's use an Official Avatar![/h3]Teravit will be providing users with several voxel avatars that can be used during the Global Alpha Test. Among these avatars is CosmicBreak Universal's Crimrose, so let's use it and explore the world of Teravit as Crimrose!

- Avatar Distribution Page
[url=https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar]https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/7b6ff7720d7e3e6cfe9790cbe7160247b98933d2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Let's make our own voxel avatar![/h3]You can make your own original avatar using MagicaVoxel!
For more information on how to download and install MagicaVoxel, and how to create and customize voxels, please visit the Avatar Distribution Page.
If we can enjoy Teravit using original characters, then why don't we recreate some of the other CosmicBreak Universal characters in addition to Crimrose as well?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/b5f46dc8bd158fcfa3160b9849b1a1fcebdd215b.jpg[/img]

- Avatar Distribution Page
[url=https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar]https://teravit.app/en/download/avatar[/url]


[h2]About the Global Alpha Test[/h2]During the Japanese Alpha Test in September, we received a lot of feedback and requests from players. We will be incorporating this feedback from the first Alpha Test in the Global Alpha Test on Steam.

The Global Alpha Test will be available from October 12th, 2021 (JST) until October 29th, 2021 (JST).



We hope to see everyone in Teravit and CosmicBreak Universal!

notes.title: Season 3 Battle Campaign
notes.content:
[url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/en/info/topic/contents/4674]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/d050181945104e8f9c8f76d2d3caf70f320e8c10.jpg[/img]   
[/url]		
	Throw yourself into the thrill of battle in the Union Wars and receive a variety of unique items during the [b]Season 3 Battle Campaign[/b], starting October 6th!	

	[h1]The Battle Campaign[/h1]	The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period. Different rewards can be earned depending on the number of Battle Cards a player has collected. There are over 100 rewards available, and many of the various items needed to improve robots can be obtained.

	You can check the Battle Campaign rewards and the number of Battle Cards you have earned by clicking the "Battle Pass" button on the lobby screen or by pressing F5.
	
		[b]Season 3 Battle Campaign Rewards[/b]	　
	[url=]Please click HERE for details regarding the reward lineup[/url]. 
	
	[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1]	[b]250,700,1300 Card Prize: A-GLG Select Box[/b]
	This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate Lightning Gun. The Alternate Lightning Guns are Limited Edition weapons with the same functionality as the Gamma Lightning Gun, but with a special look that can only be obtained here!

		[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/7333f4f15939f66b4341d15d888d2b91adf4bfe7.png[/img]
	　
	[b]550 Card Prize: Tsukikage Momiji Aut[/b]
	It's Tsukikage Momiji, dressed in a kimono with a design of autumn leaves, just like in the fall!
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/b7bcfa45b65410244efbad6dada5b1ed560ca6e4.png[/img]
	　
	[b]Campaign Period[/b]	　
	From 10/6/2021 (JST) until 1/12/2022 (JST).
	*A battle campaign will be held each season, with each season lasting three months.
	　
	[h1]About the Battle Pass[/h1]	The special reward slots in the active Battle Campaign will be exclusively accessible to Battle Pass owners. The special reward slots will offer a variety of unique prizes in addition to the normal rewards!
	　
	[b]How to Get a Battle Pass[/b]
	A Battle Pass can be purchased from the in-game Shop in the "ITEM" section for 300 Rt. Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on "Charge Rt".

	*You can still receive rewards even if you purchase the Battle Pass after a Season has started.	

	[b]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/b]	
	All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ddcec6d9bcf226c290c7689e2d8ced4bbb3e43e5.png[/img]	
	[b]How to Get Battle Cards[/b]	
	Battle Cards can be obtained based on wins, losses, and battle results in valid Union Wars rooms.

	*The amount of cards that can be earned from a match varies depending on the conditions set for the room. Please see the chart below for additional details.	
	
	[b]Breakdown of Cards Earned[/b]	
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3b319bf47ac0c462a0b0fb41816c0c9f34e69666.png[/img]	*In order to get cards, at least 10 players must be participating in the match.
	*Players whose consumed BP has reached more than 6,500 will not receive cards.
	*Players who join in the middle of a match will not receive cards.
		
	[b]Rewards for Actions[/b]	
	Players will be awarded at the end of matches based on the actions they took during the match. Depending on the number of participants in the match, the top players in the ranking of each award will get 1 additional Battle Card each.

	*The amount of players who can receive an additional reward will vary depending on the number of participants in a match.

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ad18681cd8ee7f2678c89b6fdcc1abfdb648aa35.png[/img]	*There must be at least 14 players participating in the match in order to earn additional rewards.
	*Additional cards cannot be earned if a player has won a match, as they are already at the earnable limit.
	
	[b]Please Note:[/b]
	-Battle Cards will be removed at the end of the Season.

notes.content:

Thank you for your participation in the previous Epoch Battle Renovation Event!

Information about the current Epoch Renovation Event.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1140620/view/2986433543423946151]1st Epoch Battle Renovation Event[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1140620/view/2989813780444524028]2nd Epoch Battle Renovation Event[/url]


In the event, matches will be held on the stage used in the actual Epoch Battles, regardless of the Union to which you belong. 
By participating, players can obtain great rewards including [b]Cosmo Harmonics[/b], [b]Gems[/b] and [b]Plate Cosmos I[/b] amongst others.. 

We will be conducting a survey this time as well, so please read below for further details.
We appreciate your cooperation!


We have also released the results of the previous questionnaire, which will be listed below.


[h1]◆Overview[/h1]During the event date and time, three rooms of Epoch Battle Events will be added to the "Event Battles" section of theArena. 
There will be only four game stages: "Encircled Netherlands", "Undercover Barriground", "Wiztania Defense Line" and "AgrosCorridor Ruins". 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/f5b89375dda4732425a08a3d33f393cb1d8181ca.png[/img]

The number of players in a game is 30 vs 30. 
Offensive and defensive assignments are made at random, independent of the Union. 
After the match is over, the waiting status for matching will be automatically cancelled. 

There will be no change in the rating of the player who wins or loses the match. 
By participating, players can obtain great rewards including [b]Cosmo Harmonics[/b], [b]Gems[/b] and [b]Plate Cosmos I[/b] amongst others. 
After the match, players will receive 1 Union Coin, 1 Arena Coin and 1 Angel Coin each.
The other rewards will be the same as in the 30v30 Union Wars. 


[h1]◆Rule[/h1][h3]Basic Rules[/h3]・BP consumption when robots are destroyed will become 0 for both the attacking and defending teams.
・Match tie limits will default to 5 minutes (up to 7minutes)
・Attacking victory condition: Destroy 3 Power Spots within the time limit
・Defending victory condition: Defend power spots for the time limit

The BP of the attacking side will decrease starting 1 minute after battle begins.
Time limit and BP are linked, so when the time reaches 0, the BP will also reach 0 and the attacking team will lose.
For stages with only one power spot, the power spot will reappear in the same position after the power spot is destroyed.

[h3]Power Spot[/h3]・Power Spots will no longer be able to receive healing or regen effects from players.


[h1]◆Rule Adjustment Details[/h1]・You can now get an arena card as a reward.
- The conditions required for acquisition are the same as regular Union Wars.
・The number of people required to start a game has been reduced to a minimum of 4 for each team (8 in total).
・The wait time to sortie after defeat has been shortened.
・The match time has been reduced to 5 minutes.
- Destroying the power spot will extend the match time by 1 minute. (Up to 7 minutes max.)


[h1]◆Stage Amendment Details[/h1][h3]Encircled Netherlands[/h3]・Lowered the altitude limit.
・Removed one catapult.
・A catapult for exclusive use of the defending team has been implemented.

[h3]Undercover Barriground[/h3]・Removed the Attacking side catapult.
・Adjusted the terrain near the Defending side base.

[h3]Agros Corridors[/h3]・Adjusted the position of the Power Spot.
・Adjusted the terrain near the Defending side base.

[h3]Wiztania Defense Line[/h3]・Removed the north and south passages added in the previous adjustment.
・Adjusted the terrain near the Defending side base.


[h1]◆Time Period[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/33de88398e6f8959fb279de4890b8228997cd882.png[/img]

[h1]◆Survey[/h1]Please use the form below to complete the questionnaire regarding the 3rd Epoch Battle Renovation Event.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/20fc6aa56b68c6ba6fbe0ea5ac2ab8980ab7311f.jpg[/img]
Thank you for your participation in the previous Epoch Battle Renovation Event!

Adjustments have been made based upon the feedback we have received.
Now the [b]2nd Epoch Battle Renovation Event [/b]begins!
In the event, matches will be held on the stage used in the actual Epoch Battles, regardless of the Union to which youbelong. 
By participating, players can obtain great rewards including [b]Cosmo Harmonics[/b], [b]Gems[/b] and[b]Plate Cosmos I[/b] amongst others.. 

In addition, we will be conducting a survey about this event. 
We're looking forward to your participation!


[h1]◆Outline[/h1]During the event date and time, three rooms of Epoch Battle Events will be added to the "Event Battles" section of theArena. 
There will be only four game stages: "Siege of Nedelland", "Ballygran Undercover", "Wiztania Defense Line" and "AgrosCorridor Ruins". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/f5b89375dda4732425a08a3d33f393cb1d8181ca.png[/img]
The number of players in a game is 30 vs 30. 
There are no Union limits on registration; Alpha team will be offensive and Bravo team will be defensive.
After the match is over, the waiting status for matching will be automatically cancelled. 

There will be no change in the rating of the player who wins or loses the match. 
When you participate in a match, you can randomly obtain prizes such as "Cosmo Harmonics", "Gem", and "Plate CosmosI".
After the match, you will receive a 30vs30 Union Wars prize, as well as an additional Union Coin, Arena Coin, and AngelCoin.

[h1]◆Adjustment details[/h1]
[h3]Rules[/h3].Adjusted BP consumption to 0 for attackers and defenders when robots are destroyed.
The time limit is set to 7 minutes.
The attacker wins by destroying the power spot three times within the time limit.
Defensive victory condition: Defend the power spot within the time limit.The attacker's BP will decrease as time passes, starting one minute into the battle.
The time limit and BP are linked, and when the time limit reaches zero, the BP also reaches zero, and the attacker isdefeated. 
 
In stages with only one power spot, the power spot will reappear in the same location after it is destroyed. 

[h3]Power Spots[/h3]no longer accept HP recovery from the player

[h3]Others[/h3]When opening the map, you can now see the entire stage.
The power spot's HP is now displayed at the top of the screen
The power spot's HP is now displayed on the attacker's screen
The attacker can also see the HP of the power spot


[h1]Stages[/h1][h3]Siege of Nedelland[/h3]Adjusted to make it easier for attackers to get close to power spots.
　
[h3]Vari-Gran Infiltration[/h3]Adjusted to allow attackers to move to the front line more quickly

[h3]Agaroth Corridor[/h3]Added a slope near the power spot.
　
[h3]Wiztania Defense Line[/h3]Adjusted to allow attackers to move quickly to the front lines.　
Adjusted so that defenders can move to each power spot faster
　
[h1]◆Date and Time of Event[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/115dba7c21c31286890b331173e155ab234e38b0.jpg[/img]

[url=https://forms.gle/yQZokXuXKYCu2ggC6]    Click here for the survey form.[/url] 

[h3]Responses due[/h3]Wednesday 11 August 2021, from the end of maintenance 
Until Monday, 21 July 2021 

Thank you for your continued support of CosmicBreak Universal.

notes.title: Season 2 Battle Campaign
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/8640ad9fb1597c2e29c20049c29656e4b4c58e6f.jpg[/img]

Throw yourself into the thrill of battle in the Union Wars and receive a variety of unique items during the [b]Season 2 Battle Campaign[/b], starting July 7th!

[h1]The Battle Campaign[/h1]The Battle Campaign is an event in which players collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period. Different rewards can be earned depending on the number of Battle Cards a player has collected. There are over 100 rewards available, and many of the various items needed to improve robots can be obtained.

You can check the Battle Campaign rewards and the number of Battle Cards you have earned by clicking the "Battle Pass" button on the lobby screen or by pressing F5.

[b]Season 2 Battle Campaign Rewards[/b]　
Please click [url=https://cosmicbreak-universal.com/info/topic/contents/3179]HERE[/url] for details regarding the reward lineup. 

[h1]Battle Pass Exclusive Rewards[/h1][b]450 Card Prize: A-BMG Select Box[/b]
This is a selection box where you can choose one of three color variations of Alternate Blast Guns. The Alternate Blast Guns are Limited Edition weapons with the same functionality as the Blast Missile Gun, but with a special look that can only be obtained here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/58ee0e971105430926895f2bb66b4504bdb9353d.png[/img]
　
[b]750 Card Prize: IvisSwm[/b]
Ivis has ripped off her gloomy dress and donned a bikini to embrace the summer!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/0e2502ad13556be68e8f17d0ec5cfa4de49eb1a7.png[/img]
　
[b]Campaign Period[/b]　
From 7/7/2021 (JST) until 10/6/2021 (JST).
*A battle campaign will be held each season, with each season lasting three months.
　
[h1]About the Battle Pass[/h1]The special reward slots in the active Battle Campaign will be exclusively accessible to Battle Pass owners. The special reward slots will offer a variety of unique prizes in addition to the normal rewards!
　
[b]How to Get a Battle Pass[/b]
A Battle Pass can be purchased from the in-game Shop in the "ITEM" section for 300 Rt. Rt may also be purchased from the Shop by clicking on "Charge Rt".

*You can still receive rewards even if you purchase the Battle Pass after a Season has started.

[b]Valid Battle Campaign Rooms[/b]
All standard Union Wars Rooms, available in the Arena, and Union Wars Event Battle UNION & ARK Rooms are valid Battle Campaign Rooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ddcec6d9bcf226c290c7689e2d8ced4bbb3e43e5.png[/img]
[b]How to Get Battle Cards[/b]
Battle Cards can be obtained based on wins, losses, and battle results in valid Union Wars rooms.

*The amount of cards that can be earned from a match varies depending on the conditions set for the room. Please see the chart below for additional details.

[b]Breakdown of Cards Earned[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/3b319bf47ac0c462a0b0fb41816c0c9f34e69666.png[/img]*In order to get cards, at least 10 players must be participating in the match.
*Players whose consumed BP has reached more than 6,500 will not receive cards.
*Players who join in the middle of a match will not receive cards.

[b]Rewards for Actions[/b]
Players will be awarded at the end of matches based on the actions they took during the match. Depending on the number of participants in the match, the top players in the ranking of each award will get 1 additional Battle Card each.

*The amount of players who can receive an additional reward will vary depending on the number of participants in a match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/ad18681cd8ee7f2678c89b6fdcc1abfdb648aa35.png[/img]*There must be at least 14 players participating in the match in order to earn additional rewards.
*Additional cards cannot be earned if a player has won a match, as they are already at the earnable limit.

[b]Please Note:[/b]
-Battle Cards will be removed at the end of the Season.

The 3 Guardians have decided to prepare a [b]grand new arena for a large number of heroes[/b] to battle in order to collect more Cosmos! 	

[b]50 vs 50[/b] battles can take place in this new arena!	
Players can receive [b]Cosmo Harmonics[/b] by participating.

[b]Prepare for the fiercest battle you've ever experienced in the Arena![/b]	
  
[h2]Event Period[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/c660fe01ffa8ec02767e0961e9ef839e77e92638.png[/img]

[h2]Event Details[/h2][b]A large-scale 50 vs 50 Battle Campaign will be held![/b]	
Throughout the event period, [b]a new Union Wars [50vs50] option will be added to the Event Battle section of the Arena[/b] between  07:00 to 08:00 PDT and 19:00 to 20:00 PDT.	
*The 50 vs 50 battle will first become available on 5/25 between 07:00 and 08:00 PDT. 
  
[u][Postscripted May 25th]
  The main objective in Large-Scale Battles is to bring the enemy team's BP down to 0, which can be done most effectively [b]by destroying the enemy team's 5 Power Spots.[/b]	
  [b]Destroying a Power Spot will reduce the enemy team's BP by 20%, so be sure to attack them whenever possible![/b]	
  Furthermore, [b]each team will have 1 large Power Spot worth 30% of the team BP, so don't miss any chances to destroy it![/b][/u]

notes.title: Canvas Shield Skin Contest!
notes.content:
The [b]Canvas Shield Skin Contest[/b] will be held from 4/28/2021 UTC!
Please see below for details regarding how to participate.

[h1]How to Submit Your Skin[/h1]
Please upload the Canvas Shield skin you made in CosmicBreak Universal to the
Steam Workshop with the tag "[b]Canvas Shield[/b]".

[b]How to get the Canvas Shield[/b]
The Canvas Shield can be acquired from the Angel Coin Exchange in exchange for 10 Angel Coins. Angel Coins can be acquired by participating in the Arena, Missions, and Quests.

[b]How to Create Skins[/b]
Players can create skins by accessing the Paint function from the Garage.

・For details regarding How to Create Skins, please click [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2462702221]HERE[/url].

[b]How to Upload Your Submission[/b]
After completing your design for a Skin, press the "Save" or "Export Image" button at the top right of the Skin Edit screen, and then click on the "Upload to Workshop when saving" option in the pop up menu so that it is highlighted.
Once you've selected a directory, press Save to open a new screen, and then enter the title, comment, and tags* you want to use.
*Be absolutely sure to include [b]Canvas Shield[/b] as a tag.
Once you have done the above, press the "Yes" button to upload the Skin to the Workshop.
**Check your upload on the Steam Workshop to make sure the visibility setting for the Skin is set to 
[b]Public[/b].

[b]Submission Disclaimers[/b]
-Submissions with mistakes in the tag or publish settings will be disqualified.
-Tags must be written in English, with a comma used to separate each tag (only necessary if multiple tags are used).
-In order to complete an upload, you must agree to the Steam's terms and conditions.

[b]Submission Period[/b]
From 4/28/2021
Until 5/7/2021 maintenance

[b]Participation Requirements[/b]
Anyone who meets the requirements listed out below may participate as many times as they like.
-Contestant agrees to follow the rules of the contest.
-Contestant must submit their own work.
-Amateurs and pros alike may participate.
-Minors must receive permission from a legal guardian to participate.
-Contestants must agree to Steam's Terms and Conditions.
*Submissions that contain copyrighted material outside of CosmicBreak Universal or are otherwise deemed inappropriate may be disqualified.
*In the case of a copyright infringement claim from a legitimate third party, prize-winners may have their submission disqualified.

[b]General Disclaimers[/b]
-Prizes will be distributed to the Steam ID associated with the in-game player name that uploaded the skin.
-Winners can receive their prize by logging into the game after prizes have been sent.
-Works that violate the authorship or other rights of a third party (e.g., imitating another work) will not be accepted.

[h1][b]Prizes[/b][/h1]
[b]Winners: 3 candidates[/b]
Item: SP Garapon Ticket x1

We look forward to your submissions!

notes.title: Planned Improvements for the Official Release
notes.content:
We would like to thank everyone who participated in the CosmicBreak Universal beta test.

Below, we will share a number of improvements and adjustments we are making based on the feedback we have received. We plan to implement these changes in time for the official release.

[h2]Usability Improvements[/h2]
[b]Leveling[/b]
-We have received feedback that character progression is a cumbersome process. Not only do players have to tune up equipment, but they must also level up their characters. We agree, and have decided that adjustments are necessary. In light of this, the amount of EXP now required to level up has been roughly halved.
-Previously, a character could not gain additional EXP at a level up until a cartridge was selected, and their level was raised. We are making adjustments so that EXP can be accumulated without leveling up. This will also be the case when using an [EXP Gain] item.
-The “Limit Remove” system will be removed. Previously, there were level caps at level 5 and level 8, but characters will now have level 10 as their level cap across the board. 

[b]Tutorial[/b]
We have received comments about a lack of tutorials. For the official release, we will be reimplementing the 3 Guardians Mate (during the beta test, they were temporarily removed due to an issue), and make adjustments so that the Mate system is easier to understand. 

[b]Other[/b]
-We will implement an indication for AM and HD parts that have a chance of being destroyed.
-We will implement an indication of whether a Wonder Bit’s efficiency will change based on STR or TEC values.
-We will make other miscellaneous usability improvements.

[h2]General Adjustments[/h2]
[b]Eternal Tune Ups[/b]
Previously, Eternal Tune Ups (now known as "High Eternal"), which prevent certain parts from being destroyed, were costly and not easily applied despite their importance. For this reason, we will make the following adjustments.

Eternal (new)
Detail: Prevents the destruction of the part to which it is applied.
Cost: 5
Base Chance of Success: 100%

High Eternal (updated from Eternal)
Details: Prevents the destruction of the part to which it is applied and increases HP.
Cost: 15
HP: +8
Base Chance of Success: 60%

[b]Battle Campaign[/b]
We will be making some adjustments to the Battle Campaign, which offers different rewards based on a player’s Union Wars battle results.

During the beta test period, only the first 50 levels of rewards were made available, taking into account the short period of availability for the campaign. In the official release, we will provide 100 levels with plentiful rewards. Additionally, based on the data we collected during the beta test, we have decided to increase the amount of rewards across the board (not only for normal rewards and Battle Pass rewards).For example, we plan to increase the number of Robo Cubes and Garapon Tickets in the rewards, to increase opportunities to obtain characters.

We will also be making some adjustments to Battle Cards, including easing the upper limit of BP consumption from 4,500 BP, in order to provide players with more choices.

[b]Garapon[/b]
The amount of Rt required for 20x rolls will be reduced.
Furthermore, we have received suggestions that there are too many prizes in the bronze and blue tiers, making it difficult to obtain a desired item. Therefore, we will reduce the number of items in the lineup for the bronze and blue tiers, increasing the probability of receiving a desired item.

[b]Battle Rating System[/b]
Although we made adjustments to reduce performance disparities, disparities have nonetheless arisen due to factors like player skill and character progression. By introducing the Battle Rating system, we can make adjustments so players can enjoy battles that match their abilities.

[b]Support Cartridges[/b]
We have confirmed that the survival rate of SUP types is abnormally high compared to other types. SUP type already deviates from the three-way deadlock relationship between LND, AIR, and ART types, and as such, we will remove "Guard Cartridges," which provide a net increase in survivability to SUP types (which, as mentioned, do not have a specific weakness in the first place), and replace them with different cartridges.

[b]Capacity Disparities[/b]
We will implement changes so that when all "Capacity Up" and "Internal Weapon Enhancement" cartridges have been acquired, the difference in capacity will be nearly equal regardless of the core parts, and there will be equal opportunities for tuning up.
 -M size and L size core parts in the same Cost range will be changed to have the same capacity.
 -S size will have slightly less capacity than the M and L sizes.
 -Core parts that had a low capacity in the beta test will also benefit from this change.
 -Certain core parts may have increased capacity in exchange for having lower parameters.
 -Certain characters (such as humanoids with limited customization) may have a large capacity.

[b]Other Changes[/b]
-The KDJ will be moved to the Resort Area.
-Additional miscellaneous adjustments are planned.


If you made it this far, thank you so much for taking the time to read this enormous post.
We hope to see you when CosmicBreak Universal officially launches!

-The CosmicBreak Universal Management Team

notes.title: End of Beta Announcement
notes.content:
The beta test for CosmicBreak Universal, which started on Wednesday, January 20 2021 (JST), will end today, Wednesday, February 24 2021, at 15:00 (JST).

We would like to thank everyone who participated in the beta test, especially the players who took the time to provide feedback.
Due to all of the feedback we received, we were able to make a lot of adjustments during the beta test. We were also able to find and fix many issues ahead of the launch of the Official Service.

We will have new information to share in the coming weeks regarding our plans for the Official Service, based on the suggestions we have received up until now.

As for the official launch date, we had announced that it would be in March 2021, but in light of the feedback we received, we have decided to push the date to April 2021 so we can have the time to address the ideas and issues brought forward.

Thank you so much for your support.

The Battle Campaign is an event in which players will collect [Battle Cards] by competing in the Union Wars throughout the event period. The special reward slots in the active Battle Campaign will be exclusively accessible to Battle Pass owners.
In addition to exclusive items, you will also be able to obtain a variety of unique  prizes that cannot be compared to the normal rewards!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/1995143ebb55a02c7d6a9e9fddf8c5eb616d19a6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: What is CosmicBreak Universal?
notes.content:
[b]What is CosmicBreak Universal?[/b]
CosmicBreak Universal is a new and improved international version of ‘CosmicBreak', now supporting English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese within the game, slated for release worldwide on the Steam platform in Winter 2020. Among the improvements, players will find revamped features, updated graphics, and an overhaul of the game balance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/973a37d071cccc58f802ee8b16173ddcd30e5393.png[/img]

[b]What’s Different About CosmicBreak Universal?[/b]
CosmicBreak Universal is a new international service made for the Steam platform that keeps the core elements of what made the original CosmicBreak unique intact, while incorporating a slew of changes that could not be implemented in the original title. Not only is this an improved version, but it will also be more widely available to players around the world.

[b]Optimizations and Improvements[/b]
CosmicBreak Universal will launch with a curated offering of robots and humanoids, while certain end-game content like the Core Tuning System and the Drive System will be unavailable until a later date. Such content will only be re-implemented into the game after significant adjustments have been made to them.
In addition to the above, numerous improvements have been made towards overall game balance and usability, including the simplification of status ailments, and individual adjustments to weapons and more. We believe a greater number of players will be able to enjoy the game this way. To provide an example of these changes, the Power stat on projectile weapons with a lengthy charge time will now be dramatically increased, and projectile speed across all weapons will be adjusted to prevent extreme outliers.

[b]Humanoid Model Refinements[/b]
After twelve years of service, there is a noticeable disparity between humanoid models released at the launch of CosmicBreak, and those released more recently. In CosmicBreak Universal, we have made refinements to the character models for several humanoids that debuted near the release of CosmicBreak. (Both Images - Left: Original Model | Right: Updated Model)
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/f91031f0cf69b976f87e8f65031be2be1f05c074.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/147de8d364ba5e296194188ba5132839d731f9fb.png[/img]

[b]Price Adjustments and Item Accessibility[/b]
Numerous changes have been made to increase the ease of access to desired robots, humanoids, and useful items, further encouraging a fun environment for players of all ages around the world.

notes.title: Beta and Release Dates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/973a37d071cccc58f802ee8b16173ddcd30e5393.png[/img]

[b]Reason for the Postponement[/b]
The development team has worked hard to prepare CosmicBreak Universal in time for its originally planned release in late December 2020, but as the date neared, it became apparent that the team needed more time to implement the changes that were planned, and the decision was made to change the release date to March 2021. This will give the team precious time to provide a better service.

All of the CyberStep team, would like to apologize to the fans who have been eagerly awaiting the release of the game, and thank them for their patience.

[b]About the Beta Test[/b]
A beta test will be conducted on Steam, beginning on Wednesday, January 20th, 2021. The test is currently planned to be held for three to five weeks. The development team will continue to make improvements to the game based on player feedback received throughout the test period. All are welcome to join the beta test.

CosmicBreak Universal will be free to play for both the Early Access period and the official release, so anyone with a Steam account can participate.

Those who would like to stay up to date on the upcoming beta test can visit the CosmicBreak Universal store page on Steam and click the "add to wishlist" button to receive regular updates.

During the beta test, participants will be able to access the main content of CosmicBreak Universal, which includes Missions, Quests, and the Arena. Participants will also be able to level up and strengthen their characters through this content. The balance adjustments that have been made to characters available in the beta, in addition to the prices in the Shop, the Garapon rates, and more, have all been set to simulate values close to those that will be used in the official release.

[b]Differences Between the Official Release and the Beta Test Version[/b]
Once officially released, the full version of the game will enable certain functions that will be restricted during the beta test. These functions include the ability to purchase Rt, which can be used to buy a variety of things in the game, in addition to using Present Codes.

The following features are currently being worked on::
[list]
[*] New playable characters
[*] New shop items
[*] New NPCs and NPC Quests
[*] Coin Exchanges (including the Union Coin Exchange)
[*] Campaign Mode
[*] Steam Workshop integration
[/list]

[i]* Feedback received during Early Access beta testing will be used to improve features in the game.
** Please note that user data such as robots and items acquired during Early Access beta period will be reset and will not be carried over to the full version.[/i]

[b]About CosmicBreak Universal[/b]
CosmicBreak Universal is a new and improved international version of ‘CosmicBreak' coming to Steam, with support for English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese within the game. Improvements such as revamped features, updated graphics, and an overhaul of the game balance will make for an enjoyable experience for fans and newcomers alike.
